Gaisford (Greek Prose), 1897; 2nd cl. lit. hum., 1898; prox. acc. Chancellor's Latin essay, 1899; cadet, Hong Kong, 1899; passed cadet, 1900; ag. asst. col. sec., and ag. clk. of councils, Dec., 1900, to Oct., 1901; asst. regir.-gen., Aug., 1901; mem. bd. of examrs. in Chinese, Apr., 1902; seconded for spec. serv. under govt. of India, May, 1902; J.P., June, 1902; ag. asst. col. sec., and clk. of councils, Sept., 1902, to June, 1903; sec. interpretation bd., Dec., 1902; seconded for famine relief work in Kwang Si, April to June, 1903; mem. of land ct., New Territories, Dec., 1903; ag. asst. land offr. and pol. mag., New Territories, May, 1905, to Sept., 1906; asst. col. sec. and clk. of couns., Oct., 1907; attended Internat. Opium Conf. at Shanghai, Feb., 1909; priv. sec. to H.R. the Admr., 30th Apr., 1910; ag. col. sec., and mem. exec. and legis. couns., 22nd Feb. to 6th June, 1911, 29th Nov., 1911, to 1st Feb., 1912, and from 16th Mar. to 3rd July, 1912; col. sec. B. Guiana, 1913; admstd. govt., 8th June, 1916 to 14th Apr., 1917, Apr. to Oct., 1919 and June to Oct., 1921; col. sec., Ceylon, Nov., 1922; admstd. govt., Nov., 1922 to Feb., 1923 and Apr. to Oct., 1925; gov., Hong Kong, 1st Nov. 1925; Knt. of Grace of St. John of Jerusalem.

CLEMENTI, LOCKHART.—B. 1881; served in Cape Mounted Rifles; sub-inspr., Basutoland Mounted Pol., 1905; inspr., 1913; served in European War; staff offr., 1926.

ELEMENTS, JOHN BURTON, B.Sc. Forestry (Edin.)—B. 1891; for. offr., Nyassaland, 10th Sept., 1920; ag. ch. for. offr., Oct. to Dec., 1920 and May to Dec., 1923; ch. for. offr., 19th Dec., 1923.

CLENDENNING, J., B.Sc. (Lond.), A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1888; ed. Queen's Univ., Belfast; 2nd lieut., 9th S. Staffs. Regt. (Pioneers), 1915; wounded, 31st July, 1916; lieut., Royal Engineers, 17th Nov., 1917; asst. dir. survey, Gold Coast, 1919; dep. dir., cadastral branch, 1920.

CLEVERTON, T. C. A., M.R.C.S. (Eng.): L.R.C.P. (Lond.).—B.1880; med. offr., quarantine, S. Sttlmts., Jan., 1908; med. offr., gen. hosp., Penang, Feb., 1908; med. offr., Labuan, Mar., 1908; med. offr., S. Sttlmts., Feb., 1915; med. offr., Labuan, June, 1915; in charge, treasy., Labuan, 21st Jan., 1920; pol. mag., Labuan, 23rd Apr., 1920; resumed duties as med. offr., Labuan, 21st Aug., 1921.

CLIFFE, CEDRIC ARTHUR LEWIS.—B. 1902; schol. of Eton, 1915 and of Balliol Coll., Oxford, 1921; Craven schol., 1922; 1st cls. hons., mods., 1923; Ireland schol., 1923; 1st cls. lit. hum., 1925; apptd. to C.O. after compet. exam., 20th Oct., 1926; sec., managing comtee., Imp. Bureau of Mycology, 1926.

CLIFFORD, SIR HUGH CHARLES, G.C.M.G. (1921), G.B.E., (1925), K.C.M.G.(1909); C.M.G. (1900).—B. 1866; joined Perak service, 1883; passed in Malay, Feb., 1886; collr. land rev., Kuala Kangsar, Mar., 1886; on special service to Pahang, 1887 (recd. thanks of S. of S.); ag. govt. agt. there, 1887-8; sepr., Ulu Pahang, 1889; ag. Br. res. Pahang, Sept., 1890 to Mar.,
1891, Apr. to Dec., 1891, and from Feb., 1893; took a leading part in suppression of Pahang rebellion, 1892; sec. to govt., Selangor, Dec., 1894, but continued to act as res. of Pahang; visited Cocos-Keeling Is. as special commr., June, 1894; led armed exped. into native states of Trénggánu and Kélantan to effect capture of fugitive rebel leaders, Mar.-June, 1896 (recd. thanks S. of S.); res., Pahang, July, 1896; gov. of North Borneo and Labuan, 1899 to 1901; Br. res., Pahang, 1901; ag. col. sec., Trinidad and Tobago, Sept., 1903, confirmed, 14th Sept., 1904; sent on deputation to B. Guiana in Nov., 1905, to enquire into municipal institutions; admtd. govt., 26th Mar. to 30th Aug., 1904, and from 1st Apr. to 23rd Oct., 1906; col. sec., Ceylon, 3rd May, 1907; admtd. govt., 11th July to 3rd Aug., 1907, 3rd June to 11th Oct., 1909, 30th June to 17th Nov., 1911, and from 23rd Nov., 1911, to 3rd Jan., 1912; gov., G. Coast, 11th Dec., 1912; gov., Nigeria, 23rd July, 1919; gov. of Ceylon ; Nov., (1928); concluded with M. Noufflard, the lient.-gov. of Dahomey, in Aug., 1914, an agreement for the temporary partition between the British and French Govts., and for the provisional administration of Togoland; admtd. Br. sphere of occupation, Togoland, concurrently with the G. Coast, from Aug., 1914, to Aug., 1919; chmn., comte., on W. African trade and taxation, Oct.-Nov., 1921 (received thanks of S. of S.); is part author, with Sir Frank Swettenham, of a Malayan dictionary, and author of more than a dozen books, mostly on Malayan subjects, and of a translation of the penal code into Malay; also of a history of the G. Coast regt. in the E. African campaign.

CLIFT, HON. J. AGOSTUSS, C.B.E. (1918), K.C. — Called to the bar, 1884; M.H.A. Newfoundland, 1889; speaker of assembly, 1891; clk. of assembly, 1893-97; elected to assembly, representing Twillingate dist., 1900; re-elected, 1904; min. of agric. and mines and mem. of cabinet, 1904; re-elected, Twillingate dist., 1908 and 1913; min. of agric. and mines and mem. of cabinet, 1918.

CLIPHAM, PHILIP RICHARD. — B. 1903; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 31st Sept., 1920.

CLIVE, CAPT. J. H.—Asst. dist. commr., Kenya, May, 1920.

CLOUGH, ERNEST MARSHALL OWEN, C.M.G. (1921).—B. 1873; ed. at the Mercers' Schl. and in Germany; served in S. African war, H.A.C. field battery (Queen's medal with three clasps), 1900-01; priv. sec. to the late Hon. Sir R. Solomon, G.C.M.G., 1901-03; accompanied him when representing S. Africa at Delhi Durbar, 1903; clk. of exec. and legis. couns., Transvaal, 1903-1907; clk. of legis. coun., Transvaal, 1907-1910; clk. of senate, Union of S. Africa, since 1910; accompanied S.A. parly. dels. to England upon Dominion war organisation visit and confce., 1916; served European war; lieut., Cape Garrison Arty., and O.C., armoured train, S.A. Rebellion and German S.W. Africa, 1914-15; capt., R.F.A., France and Italy, 1917-18; sec., speaker's confce. on the future constitution of the senate, 1920; chmn., S.A. training ship "Gen. Botha" from 1921; hon. sec., S. African branch, Empire Parl. Asso.; from 1911 and organised visit of delegations from all Empire parlys. to S. Africa, 1924; author of the "South African Parliamentary Manual" and various papers on constitutional questions and parly. procedure.

CLUBB, HON. WILLIAM RIRD—B. 1884; ed. Manitoba Public Schls., Winnipeg Business Coll., and Manitoba Agrl. Coll.; farmer; served on Morris munic. coun., 1916-20; mem., leg. assembly for Morris, Manitoba, 1920-22; re-elec., July, 1922; min. of public works, Manitoba, 8th Aug., 1922; re-elec. for Morris by accl., 26th Aug., 1922.

CLUTTERBUCK, P.A., M.C.—B. 1897; schol. of Malvern Coll. and of Pembroke Coll., Cambridge, 1915; coman., sp. res. of offrs., Coldstream Guards, Jan., 1916; lieut., Sept., 1916; capt. and adjt., 3rd batt., Oct., 1917; M.C. and ment. in despe., 1918; demob., 1919; apptd. under reconstruction scheme, ast. prin., G.P.O., 1st Sept., 1919; transf. to C.O., 13th Feb., 1922; sec., managing comte., Imperial Bureau of Mycology, 1923; addnl. pvt. sec. to parly. under sec. (Lord Arnold), June-Oct., 1924; sec., agrl. advisory comte., 1924-26.

COAKER, HON. SIR WM. F., K.B.E. (1923).—President, fisherman's protective union, Newfoundland; M.H.A. for Bonavista, 1913; M.H.A., Twillingate, 1914; mem. of tonnage comte., 1917; M.E.C., 1917; min. without portfolio, 1918.

COATES, J.—Ast. govt. printer, Uganda Prot., 27th May, 1910; ag. supt., govt. press, E. Africa Prot., June, 1911 to Feb., 1912; govt. printer and controller of stationery, Uganda Prot., 17th June, 1914.

COATES, JOHN SPENNER.—B. 1878; prin. min. survr., Ceylon, Sept., 1910; designation now changed to govt. mineralogist and salt adviser.

COATES, Rt. HON. JOSEPH GORDON, P.C. (1926), M.C.—B. 1878; ed. privately; mem. of New Zealand parl., since 1911; min. of justice, 1919-20; P.M.G., 1919-25; min. of pub. wks., 1920-26; nativ. min., 1921; min. of rly., 1923; prime min., 1925; N.Z. rep. at Imp. Confce., 1926; served with N.Z. Exped. Force as capt. and major, 1916-1919; awarded M.C. with bar.

COATS, ROBERT HAMILTON, B.A., F.S.S.(hon.), F.R.C.S.—B. 1874; ed. Toronto Univ.; bankers' scholarship in polit. economy, and Wyld prize, English; on staff of "Toronto Globe," 1897-1900; editor, Labour Gaz., and ch. statistician, dept. of labour, 1901-12; mem., comsn. on the cost of living, 1913-14; dom. statistician and contrl. of census, 1914; author of "The Labour Movement in Canada" (Canada and its Provinces); joint author of life of James Douglas (Makers of Canada series); offl. del. to Br. Empire Statistical Confce., 1920; mem. of comsn. on statistics under the League of Nations, 1920; mem., International Statistical Inst.

COBT, W. GRAHAM, M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.).—Cert. of London S.T.M.; medical officer, N. Nigeria (W.A.M.S.), 24th April, 1912.

COCHRAN, PETER CAMPBELL, B.A. (Oxon).—B. 1870; ed. Loretto schl., Scotland, and Oriel Coll., Oxford; Scotch law agt., Boer war, 1900-02; ast. mag., Lydenburg, 1902; Vereeniging, 1904; ast. sec., law dept., 1906; mag., Heidelberg, 1906; Barberton, 1911; Ermelo, 1914; Germiston, 1915; Bloemfontein, 1920; Durban, 1st Mar., 1926.

COCHRANE, CHARLES WALTER HAMILTON.—B. 1876; ed. Repton and Merton Coll., Oxford (exhr.); 1st cls. class. mods., 1897; 2nd cls. lit. hum., 1899; B.A., 1899; cadet, F.M.S. civ. serv., 1899; ag. ast. sec. to res.-gen., 1901; ag. ast. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, 1904; ag. ast. sec. to res., Perak, 1907; ag. 2nd mag., Kuala Lumpur, 1908; ag. 2nd ast. dist. offr., Krian, 1910; ag. dist. offr., Coast, Negri Sembilan, 1911; ag. collector land rev., Seremban, 1912; ag. temporarily as British res., Negri Sembilan, 15th to 24th May, 1914; offr. of cls. III., 1st July, 1915; attached to C.O., Sept.,
1915 to June, 1916; dep. pub. pros., Perak, 5th Oct., 1916; chief asst. dist. offr., Kinta, 21st June, 1917; sec. to res., Perak, 18th May, 1919; ag. under sec. to govt., F.M.S., 7th Dec., 1921; under sec. to govt., F.M.S., Dec., 1921; ag. Br. res., Negri Sembilan, Apr., 1924; resumed duty as under-sec., F.M.S., Oct., 1924; ag. gen. adviser, Johore, May, 1926.

COCKBURN, THE HON. SIR JOHN ALEX., K.C.M.G. (1900); M.D. (Lond.).—B. 1860; mem. of house of assem., S. Australia, 1884-1898; min. of educn., 1885, to June, 1887; premier and ch. sec., 1889-90; again min. of educn. and agricul., 1893; agt.-gen. for S. Australia in London, 1898-1901.

COCKER, THOMAS BERNARD.—B. 1898; ed. Oldham Gram. Schl. and St. John's Coll., Camb.; R.N. acount. branch, 1918-19; B.A., 1920 (pt. I., class. tripes); L.L.B., 1921 (pt. II., law tripes), Gray's Inn; cadet, S. Stltims., 1921; ag. dep. regiar., sup. ct., Singapore, 17th Oct., 1921.

COCKEY, C. E. E.—Ed. St. Edwards Schl. and Wadham Coll., Oxford; M.A.; served in France and Salonica; 3rd Devons, atchd. 2nd Glouc. Regt., May, 1915, to Jan., 1919; ag. capt.; mentd. in despe.; asst. dist. comsnr., Gold Coast, 13th June, 1919.

COCKMAN, HERBERT JAMES, D.F.C.—B. 1898; ed. St. Paul's Schl. and Merton Coll., Oxford; 2nd lieut., Royal Flying Corps, Apr., 1917; cadet, F.M.S., 10th Dec., 1921; attd. to Fed. secretariat, Jan., 1922; attd. to chandu monopoly, Kuala Lumpur, Aug., 1922; ag. 2nd asst. adviser, Muar, Johore, July, 1923.

COCKRAM, BEN.—B. 1903; ed. Victoria, Taunton's Schl. and Oxford; hist. schol., Queen's Coll., 1921-25; 1st cls., mod. hist., 1925; Goldsmith's gen. student, 1926; lat. cls., med. and mod. hist., London, 1923; fellow, Michigan, 1925-26; Ph.D., 1926; apptd. after compet. exam. asst. prin., Dominions Office, 4th Nov., 1926.

COCKSHUTT, HENRY.—B. 1868; ed. pub. and high schls., Bradford; pres., Cockshutt Plough Co., since 1911; pres. of several other large manufacturing concerns; mayor of Bradford, Ont., 1899-1900; pres., Bradford bd. of trade, 1898; pres., Canadian manufacturers' assn., 1906-7; organised and financed the 215th batt., Bradford, of which he was lieut.-col., and now hon. col.; unsuccessful candidate for the H. of C., 1917; lieut.-gov., Ont., 10th Sept., 1921.

CODERRE, HON. LOUIS, K.C., B.A., LL.B.—B. 1865; ed. primary schl., St. Gurs, Hyacinthe and Montreal Colleges and Laval Univ.; called to the bar, 1892; head of the firm Coderre and Coderre, advocates, Montreal; city attorney, St. Henri, 1896-1906; syndic of the Montreal bar, 1904-1909; unsuccessful cand. for Quebec legislature, 1908, and for H. of C. in same year; elec. to H. of C. for Hochelaga, Sept., 1911; sworn of the P.C. for Canada and sec. of state, Oct., 1912; also min. of mines, 1913; judge, super. ct., Quebec, 1915.

CODRINGTON, HUMPHREY WILLIAM.—B. 1879; ed. Winchester and New Coll. Oxford (B.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1903; off. asst., Galle Kachcheri, July, 1904; Batticaloa Kachcheri, Jan., 1905; Kurunegala Kachcheri, May, 1906; Kandy Kachcheri, Nov., 1906; asst. govt. agt., Kegalla, Aug., 1907; off. asst. to govt. agt.; Colombo, Nov., 1907; asst. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Dec., 1908; ditto, Kegalla, Aug., 1911; addtl. asst. col. sec., Aug., 1914; asst. govt. agt., Puttalam and Chilaw, Aug., 1914; asst. govt. agt., Kandy, July, 1915; ditto, Puttalam and Chilaw, Sept., 1915; ditto, Kandy, Oct., 1915; asst. govt. agt., Matale, Apr., 1916; on military duty, 1918; ag. govt. agt., N. Prov., Oct., 1919; comsnr. under the Buddhist Temporalities Ord., Mar., 1920; govt. agt., prov. of Sabaragamuwa, in addn., Sept., 1921; ag. P.M.G., Jan., 1924; regiar.-gen., Mar., 1924; ag. contr., rev., Apr., 1925; addnl. contr., rev., Dec., 1925; P.M.G., Jan., 1926; govt. agt., N.W.P., Apr., 1926.

COE, THOMAS PEROWNE, M.C.—B. 1887; ed. Norwich Gram. Schl. and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; (schol.) 2nd cls., class. mods., 1908, 3rd cls. lit. hum., 1910; B.A., 1910; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1910; ag. 2nd asst. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, July, 1911; ag. 2nd asst. sec. to ch. sec., Feb., 1912; passed cadet, Dec., 1912; offr., cls. V., Dec., 1913; temp. 2nd-lieut., 7th (service) battn., Norfolk Regt., 11th Mar., 1915; temp. lieut., 7th (service) battn., Norfolk Regt., 27th Oct., 1915; G.S.O., 3rd grade, with rank of temp. capt., trans. to Gen. List, 28th July, 1917; temp. caps., Gen. List (Gen. Staff), 1st May, 1918; brig. maj., 9th May, 1918; offr., cls. IV., 1st Jan., 1919; demob., Feb., 1919; 2nd asst. sec., Fed. secretariat, Nov., 1919; ag. priv. sec. to ch. sec. in addition, Nov., 1919 to June, 1920; ag. 2nd asst. sec. to govt., 1st July, 1920; 2nd-lieut. M.S.V.R., Apr., 1921; ag. capt., Nov., 1921; capt., Aug., 1922; supernumy. offr., cls. III., Nov., 1922; major, M.S.V.R., Jan., 1923; dist. offr., Batang Padang, July, 1924.

COGHLAN, SIR CHARLES PATRICK JOHN, K.C.M.G. (1926), KT. BACH. (1910).—B. 1863; ed. St. Aidan's Coll., Grahamstown, S. African Coll., Cape Town; served as capt. in Kimberley Town Guard (medal and clasp); solr., M.L.C., S. Rhodesia; 1st premier of S. Rhodesia, 1st Oct., 1923.

COGHLAN, FREDERICK ALBERT.—B. 1859; Under sec., chief secretary's dept., New South Wales, Aug., 1910-1914; auditor gen., N.S.W., May, 1914.

COGILL, FRANK.—Assoc. Royal Schol. of Mines, London; secy. for mines, Gold Coast, 1903.

COHEN, EZCHIEL, M.B.E. (1924).—B. 1882; clk., Capt. govt. rlys., May, 1900; transf. to Imperial Mil. Rlys., Nov., 1900; transf. to Bech. Prot. service and attached to office of high comsnr. for S. Africa, Aug., 1901; asst. Imp. acctnt., Apl., 1918; prin. clk., Nov., 1923.

COHEN, W. S.—Ed. at Clifton Coll. and Trin. Coll., Camb.; 2nd class tripes, 1893; M.A.; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple; sec., imigr. (temporary), O.R.C., 1902.

COLE, ARNOLD KIETLAND.—B. 1884; sec. to bd. of educn., Bahamas, 1907; ag. res. justice, Rum Cay, 1908; ag. inspr. and genl. supt. of schools, 1910, 1911, 1913; 3rd clk., treasy. dept., 1913; 1st clk., P.O., 1914; oh. clk. and ast. examr. offr., cust. dept., 1st Aug., 1921; ag. contrlr., cust., in 1922, 1923 and 1924; ast. contr. and examining offr., 5th Dec., 1923; ag. contr., asst., July to Aug., 1924 and 20th Sept. to 8th Nov., 1925; surrr., shipping, 25th Mar., 1925; ag. contr. cust. and regiar., shipping from 13th Apr., 1926.

COLE, V. G.—Ast. dist. comsnr., Kenya, June, 1921.

COLEBATCH, HON. SIR HAL PATEHALL, KT. BACH. (1927).—B. 1872; ed. Goolwa, S. Australia; M.L.C. for E. Prov., W. Australia, May, 1912; col. sec., min. for educn., min. of pub. health and leader of legis. coun., 1916-19; premier, W. Australia for short period, 1919; min. of educn. and pub. health, 17th May, 1919; agt.-gen. for W. Australia, 1923.
COLLETT, J.W., M.R.C.P., M.R.C.S.—Med. offr., S. Nigeria, 1901; author of "Text Book of Physiology and Hygiene."

COLLIÈ, JAMES, O.B.E. (1920).—Ck., financ. adviser's office, O.R.C., June, 1900; ch. examiner of accts., audit dept., July, 1901; ch. clk. and acct., treas., July, 1902; asst. treas., O.F.S., July, 1907; under-treas., July, 1909; ag. under-sec. for finance, Union of S. Africa, May, 1910; asst. contr. and audr.-gen., July, 1910; dep. acctg. offr., Union agr. dept., Dec., 1911; sec., S. W. Africa, 1915; chmn., war losses commn., S. W. Africa, 1919; chmn., debts sttlmt. bd., S. W. Africa, 1921; sec., mining industry bd., 1922; sec., old age pension commn., 1926.

COLLIER, HON. PHILLIP.—B. 1873; M.L.A. for Boulder, W. Australia, since 1905; min. for mines and rlys. in Scaddan govt., 1911-14, and of mines and water supply, 1914-16; leader, parly. labour party, May, 1917; premier, W. Australia, Apr., 1923.

COLLIER, REGINALD.—B. 1870; stock inspr.; Basutoland, 1910; sub-inspr., Basutoland Mounted Pol., 1915; inspr., 1924; Zulu Rebellion, 1906; Great War, 1917-19.

COLLINS, CHARLES HENRY, B.A., Lond.—B. 1887; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., 12th Nov., 1910; attached to the Karunegala Kachcheri, 16th Dec., 1910; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., N.W. Prov., Apl., 1912; ag. pol. mag., Puttalam, Sept., 1912; office asst. Kandy Kachcheri, July, 1913; ag. pol. mag., Kandy, June, 1914; asst. land sttlmt. offr., May, 1915; ag. asst. govt. agt., Puttalam and Chilaw, July, 1915; asst. land sttlmt. offr., Sept., 1915; ag. asst. govt. agt., Puttalam and Chilaw, Oct., 1915; addtl. asst. govt. agt., ditto, Sept., 1916; office asst. to govt. agt., W. Prov., Oct., 1916; 2nd asst. col. sec., Oct., 1917; 3rd asst. col. sec., Sept., 1920; 2nd asst. col. sec., Jan., 1922; prin. asst. col. sec., Feb., 1924; addnl. asst. col. sec., Oct., 1925; dep. collr., cust., Dec., 1925.

COLLINS, JAMES RICHARD, C.B.E. (1923), C.M.G. (1920).—B. 1869; treasy. clk., Victoria, 1886; acctnt. to Commonwealth of Aust. treasy., 1901; sec. to treasy., 1916; finan. adviser to high commr., London, and mem., London bd. of advice of Commonwealth Bank of Australia, 1926.

COLLINS, JOSEPH THOMAS, M.A., LL.M.—Scholar and medallist of Trin. Coll., Melbourne; exhibitioner, scholar and honourman in arts and laws, Melbourne Univ.; barrister-at-law, Victoria, 1894; legal adviser to Roy. Comn. on Local Govt. Law, 1902; mem. and subsequently chmn. of Roy. Comn. on Unification or Federation of Municipalities in Victoria, 1903-5; parly. draughtsman, Victoria, since July, 1910; author, in conjunction with Mr. C. H. Meaden, of "Local Government Law and Practice."

COLLINS, SIR ROBT. HENRY MUIRHEAD, KT. BACH. (1919), C.M.G. (1904).—B. 1852; retired lieut. R.N.; entered R.N., 1866; served in flying squadrons in 1888 and 1872; sub-lieut., June, 1872; served on Channel and Australian stations to 1876; lieut., June, 1876; apptd. to Victorian naval forces (Australia), Dec., 1878; comdr. Victorian naval forces, 1884; sec. for defence for Victoria, 1888; sec. to dept. of defence, Commonwealth of Aust., 1st Mar., 1901; late offl. sec. in Great Britain for the C. of A.

COLLINS, W. H., Ph. D., F.R.S.C.—B. 1878; ed. Univ. of Toronto, 1904; Heidelberg Univ., 1907; Chicago Univ., 1909; Univ. of Wisconsin, 1911; asst. geologist, geol. surv. of
Can., 1905; jun. geol., 1912; geol., 1914; fellow, Royal Soc. of Can., 1918; dir., geol. surv. of Can., 1920; ex-off. mem., Can. Inst. Min. Met.; mem., Geol. Soc. of America, 1920; has pub. numerous papers and memoirs on pre-cambrian geol. and petrology.

COLLISSON, PERCIVAL LORIMER, O.B.E. (Mil.), 1919.—B. 1883; ed. at Warminster and King's Coll., London; apptd. examt., E. and A. dept., 1901; col. aud. branch, Sept., 1905; examr. of accts., O.R.C., Jan., 1906; rejoined col. aud. branch, Jan., 1908; asst. auditor, N. Nigeria, Sept., 1908; ag. local auditor, 1909-10; 2nd cls. elk., col. audit., 1914; mil. audit., E. Africa Exped. Force, 1916 (twice ment. in desps.); senr. asst. auditor, E.A.P., Apr., 1919; ag. auditor, E.A.P., 1920; audr., Fiji and W. Pacific, 1922; audr., N. Rhodesia, 17th Aug., 1924.

COLLYMORE, ERNEST ALLAN, M.A. (Oxon.)—B. 1893; ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados and Merton Coll., Oxford; 2nd cls. hons. final schl. of jurisprudence, 1914; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1920; serv. in E. Lancs. Regt., 1914-19; capt., Oct., 1915; capt., Barbados Vols. and O.C., cadet corps of the island, 1921-26; sen. mag., Bridgetown and dist. A, June, 1925; recvr. of wrecks, Aug., 1925; ag. judge, asst. ct. of appeal, July to Nov., 1925 and from June, 1926.

COLMAN, EUGENE ERNEST.—B.A. Cantab.; cadet, S. Stltmts., Oct., 1902; ag. 4th mag., Sing., Oct., 1903; passed final exam. in Malay, July, 1904; ag. 3rd mag., Sing., Mar., 1906; asst. to res., Malacca, July, 1910; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, and asst. to res., Malacca, 8th July, 1911; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, 1st Jan., 1912; ag. dep. regar., Penang, 23rd Sept., 1912; offr. of cls. IV., 21st Dec., 1914, but continued to act as dep. regar., ag. 1st mag., Penang, 20th Apr., 1915; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, 26th Apr., 1915; on spec. duty in Singapore, 28th Dec., 1916; ag. dep. regar., sup. ct. and asst. offr. assignee, Penang, 27th July, 1916; suprntry. offr. of cls. 3, 1st Jan., 1919, continuing as ag. dep. regar., sup. ct. and asst. assignee, Penang; regar., dist. judge and mag., Malacca, June, 1920; temp. 2nd lieut. ag. capt., Malay and S. Stltmts. Volunteer Force (Malacca), 1st Jan., 1922; ag. dist. judge, Singapore, Feb., 1924; ag. asst. offr. assignee, Singapore, Dec., 1924; ag. solr.-gen., S.S., May, 1925; ag. regar., companies and offr. assignee, S.S., June, 1925.

COLVILLE, ERNEST FREDERICK, C.M.G. (1927).—Ed. Westminster and Christ Church, Oxford; B.A., 1901; asst. res., Nyasaland Prot., Mar., 1905; ag. asst. chief sec., Mar., 1914; ag. priv. sec. and A.D.C. to gov., Sept., 1914; res., 2nd grade, Apr., 1917; prov. commr., 1st June, 1921.

COMBE, SIR RALPH MOLYNEUX, K.T. BACH. (1920).—Ed. at Haileybury Coll. and Exeter Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1894; called to the bar, Inner Temp., 1897; Crown advocate, E. Africa Prot., 4th Aug., 1905; mem. of exec. and legis. coun., 1907; atty.-gen., E.A.P., 1912; atty.-gen., Nigeria, 1913; ch. just., Nigeria, 1918.

COMMISSIONG, TERENCE BERTRAND.—B. 1893; 3rd cls. col. sec.'s office, Grenada, 1st Apr., 1909; 2nd cls., gov.'s office, 1st June, 1915; 2nd cls., col. sec.'s office, 1st Dec., 1919; ag. cls. elk., col. sec.'s, office elk. of coun., med. regis., and man. gov't printing sub-dept., Feb.-Sept., 1920; seconded for active serv. 19th Sept., 1915 to 25th Oct., 1919; awarded meritorious serv. med. in German E. African campaign, 3rd June, 1916; apptd. J.F., Grenada, in recog. of war serv., 19th July, 1919; oh. elk., col. sec.'s, office, elk. to exec. com., med. regis. and man., govt. printing dept., 1st May, 1921.

*CONGREVE, GEN. SIR WALTER NORRIS, V.C., G.C.B., K.C.E. (1917), C.B. (1911), M.V.O. (1903), D.C.—B. 1862; ed. Harrow; ent. Rifle Brigade, 1886; capt., 1893; major, 1901; lieut.-col., 1901; col., 1908; maj.-gen., 1915; lieut.-gen., 1918; gen., 1922; served, S. Africa, 1899-1902 (wounded, twice ment. in desps.), V.C.; Queen's med., seven clasps, King's med., two clasps); European war, 1914-18 (desps.); commdr., schl. of musketry, Hythe; G.O.C., troops in Palestine; G.O.C.-in-ch., Southern Command, 1922; gov. and commdr-in-ch., Malta, 20th May, 1924; assumed govt., 29th June, 1924.

CONNOLLY, HON. SIR JAMES DANIEL, K.T. BACH. (1920).—B. 1870; ed. Warwick Pub. Schl. and Catholic Schl.; M.L.C., Western Australia, 1902; col. sec. and min. of com. and lab., 1906; col. sec. and min. of pub. health, 1910; leader of leg. coun. from 1906 to 1911; M.L.A. for Perth, 1914; agrt. genl. in London for Western Australia, 1917-23.

CONWAY, WILLIAM EWAN.—B. 1893; ed. High Schl., Dundee; govt. travelling schl. master, 10th Dec., 1913; 2nd cls., C.S.O., Mar., 1916; ag. cls. and priv. sec. to govt. of Falkland Is., June, 1916 to Apr., 1917 and Sept., 1917 to Apr., 1920; collr. of cust., G. Coast, Oct., 1920.

COOK, FREDERICK.—B. 1888; ed. Leeds Gram. Schl.; in journalism in Canada since 1832; Canadian correspondent of "The Times," London, for 20 years; school trustee and alderman, Ottawa; mayor of Ottawa, 1902-3; sec. British Columbia Better Terms Com., 1914-15; dep. King's printer of Canada, 1st July, 1915 to 1st May, 1920; chmn. of editorial comttee. of Dom. govt., 1920-23; supervisor, govt. publications, 1923; author of "Commercial Canada," "The Relations of Ottawa to the Federal authority"; edited "Canadian Who's Who," (pub. by "The Times"), 1909.

COOK, RT. HON. SIR JOSEPH, P.C. (1914); G.C.M.G. (1918).—B. 1860; mem. of H. of R., Commonwealth of Australia, since 1901; postm.-gen., N.S. Wales, 1894-1898; min. for mines and agric., 1898-9; min. of defence, C. of A., June, 1909; prime minister, C. of A., June, 1913-Sept., 1914; min. for the Navy, 1917; ditto, from 10th Jan., 1918; high commr. in London for C. of A., Nov., 1919.

COOKE, AUBREY.—B. 1890; ed. at Stonyhurst Coll. and Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford (Charles Oldham classical scholar); 2nd cls. class. Hons. Mods., 1910; Goldsmith's exhibn. in Classics and Divinity, 1910; 2nd cls. Lit. Hum., 1912; B.A., 1912; apptd., after compet. exam., 2nd cls. elk., C.O., 13th Oct., 1913; on military service from 13th Apr., 1917 to 16th March, 1919; asst. priv. sec. to Lord Milner, 17th Mar., 1919; priv. sec. to Col. Amery, 1st Jan., 1920; prin., 1st Apr., 1920.

COOKE, EDWARD ROBERT CARL, M.C., B.A. (Cantab.), M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P.—B. 1886; ed. Cambridge Univ. and Univ. Coll. Hosp., London; temp. commr., R.A.M.C., 2nd Sept., 1914; med. offr., 2nd Scottish Rifles, France; ag. major, R.A.M.C. and divnl. anti-malaria offr., 1919; med. offr., F.M.S.R., Jan., 1922.

COOKE, HERBERT SUTTON, O.B.E. (1919)—C.M.R., 1893-99; Basutoland mtd. pol., 1899-1901; inspr., native affrs. dept., Transvaal, Dec., 1901; sen. inspr., Mar., 1902; dist. contr., Johannesburg, July, 1903; chief pass offr., July, 1908; asst. dir. of native labour (Union), Apr., 1912; asst. dir.,
infrn. bureau, dept. of defence, 1914-15; maj., Union Defence Force—political services in East Africa, 1916-17; inspr.; pub. serv. comnr., 1921; ch. native comsnr. and dir., native labour, Johannesburg, 1924.

COOKE, JOHN CARL, L.R.C.P., L.M., (Edin.), L.M.S. (Ceylon).—B. 1867; med. astt., Ceylon, Feb., 1890; sub. astt. col. surg., Oct., 1892; dep. astt. col. surg., May, 1899; med. offr., Sept., 1906; provl. surg., W.P., June, 1920; ag. astt. prin. civ. med. offr., Oct., 1924 to May, 1925; astt. dir., med. services, Oct., 1925.

COOKE, S. V.—Astt. dist. comsnr., E.A.P., Jan., 1917.

COOKE, WILLIAM ERNEST, M.A., F.R.A.S.—Cadet, Adelaide observatory, 1878; B.A. Adel. Univ., 1883; astt. astronomer, Adel. obser., 1884; M.A., Adel. Univ., 1889; govt. astronomer, W.A., 1896; govt. astronomer, New South Wales, 1912-26; prof. of astronomy at Sydney Univ.

COOKSON, CLAUDE EDWARD.—Capt., reserve of offrs.; barrister-at-law; educ. at Eton (King's scholar, 1891-97); served in regular army, 1899-1910; capt., 1908; with Bedfordshire regt. in India, Gibraltar and Bermuda; station staff offr., Aden, 1907-8; ag. brigade major, 1908; astt. comsnr. of police, Gold Coast, Sept., 1911; extra A.D.C. to Mr. J. J. Thorburn, C.M.G., gov. of G. Coast, Feb. to May, 1912; comsnr. of police, G. Coast, Jan., 1915; astt. col. sec., July, 1915; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, May, 1919; inspr.-gen. of prisons, 28th Feb., 1920; title changed to dir. of prisons, Nov., 1926; senr. astt. col. sec., Sierra Leone, 3rd Feb., 1926.

COOLING, HAROLD GEORGE, B.A.—B. 1899; ed. at Birmingham and Cambridge Univs.; supt., educn. dept., N. Provs., Nigeria, 7th Sept., 1921.

COOLS-LARTIGUE, THEODORE.—B. 1867; ed. at Mount Saint Mary's Coll., Derbyshire; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1889; admitted to the bar, St. Lucia, 1889; ditto, Leeward Is., 1894; ag. registr., St. Lucia, 1891; ag. mag. in 1903-4; ag. registr., St. Lucia, 1906-7; ag. mag., 1911; elective mem., Castries town bd., 1903-1912; registr. and prov. marshal, Dominica, and also supplementary mag., Roseau, Dominica, Feb., 1912; offl. mem. leg. coun., Dominica, visiting just. of Dominica prison and J.P., 1912; govt. mem., Roseau town bd., 1914; valuation comsnr. for assessing of taxes, 1916; ag. crown atty. and mem. exec. coun., 1916-19; crown atty. and registr., sup. ct., Oct., 1919.

COOMARASWAMY, CHINNAPPAN.—B. 1887; ed. Hindu Coll., Jaffna, and Royal Coll., Colombo; cadet, local div., Ceylon civ. serv., April, 1910; extra office astt. to govt. agt., Batticaloa, Apr., 1910; ag. office astt. to ditto, May, 1912; pol. mag., Matara, May, 1913; pol. mag. and office astt. to govt. agt., Puttalam, June, 1913; pol. mag., Chilaw, Feb., 1914; pol. mag., Point Pedro, June, 1916; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Feb., 1918; ditto, Chilaw and Puttalam, Mar., 1920; addnl. astt. govt. agt., Chilaw and Puttalam, in addn., Aug., 1920; comsnr. of requests, Colombo, May, 1922; dep. comsnr., stamps, May, 1925; dist. judge, Kalutara, Apr., 1926; dep. comsnr., stamps, May, 1926.

COOMARASWAMY, VALUPILLAI.—B. 1892; Cadet, local division, Ceylon civ. serv., Mar., 1913; attached to Puttalam Kachcheri, Mar., 1913; Anuradhapura Kach., June, 1913; ag. addtnl. office astt., Anuradhapura Kach., Nov., 1913; ag. pol. mag., Puttalam, Feb., 1914; extra office astt. to astt. govt. agent, Puttalam and Chilaw, in addition to his own duties, Mar., 1914; pol. mag., Negombo, July, 1917; ditto, Dandaganuwa, July, 1918; office astt. to govt. agt., S. Prov., Feb., 1919; pol. mag., Panadura, Oct., 1920; itg. pol. mag., W. Prov., July, 1923; dist. judge, Kegalla, June, 1924.

COOPE, ARTHUR EGERTON.—B. 1888; ed. Fonthill Schl., St. Edward's Schl., and Keble Coll., Oxford; B.A. Oxon.; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1911; ag. 2nd astt. dist. offr., Tapah, Oct., 1912; passed cadet, June, 1913; ag. astt. dist. offr., lands, Kinta, Dec., 1913; offr., cls. V, Dec., 1914; astt. dist. offr., Ipoh, May, 1915; offr., cls. IV, Jan., 1919; astt. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Apr., 1919; dist. offr., Kuala Selangor, Mar., 1921; dist. offr., Ulu Kelantan, May, 1921; dist. offr., Pasir Puteh, June, 1922; offr., cls. III, Nov., 1923; offg. astt. advr., lands, Kedah, May, 1924.

COOPER, EVANS GUSTAVUS.—B. 1875; astt. clk. of courta, Jamaica, 1893; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1912; clerk of cts., Hanover, 15th Dec., 1912; J.P., 1913; ag. res. mag. on various occasions; supernumy. res. mag., 1st June, 1923; res. mag., 1st June, 1924.

COOPER, PHILIP WARD, O.B.E. (1919).—B. 1877; ed. Marlborough Coll.; cad. audit branch, E. and A. Dept., 1st Dec., 1899; astt. local auditor, E. Africa and Uganda Prots., 9th Oct., 1900; ag. local auditor, Uganda, 23rd Dec., 1901 to 15th June, 1902; astt. collr., Uganda, 4th Jan., 1904, with seniority from 31st Mar., 1902; collr., 1st Apr., 1905; ag. prov. comsnr., Western Prov., Uganda, 9th Sept., 1913; prov. comsnr., Sept., 1916.

COOPER, WILLIAM D.—B. 1902; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 16th Oct., 1920.

COPE, WILLIAM VIPOND.—B. 1872; ed. pub. and model schls., Ottawa; clk. and ch. clk. in supt.'s office, C.P.R., Ottawa, 1890-1903; later, divn.-engnr.'s office, Calgary, Alberta, 1903-6; clk., asctn.'s br., dept. of rlys. and canals, Ottawa, 1st Jan., 1907; astt. deptl. audr., 1st Oct., 1911; deptl. audr., 1st Apr., 1913; finan. comptlr., 1st Apr., 1919.

COPP, HON. ARTHUR BLISS.—B. 1870; ed. pub. schls., prov. normal schl., Mt. Allison Univ., New Brunswick, Dalhousie Law Schl., Halifax, N.S., Harvard Law Schl. (L.L.B. 1894); admitted to bar, N.B. 1895; memm., legis. ass., N.B., 1901-12; el. to H.C., bye-el., Feb., 1916; re-el., g.e., 1917 and 1921; sec. of state of Canada, 29th Dec., 1921.

CORDEAUX, MAJOR SIR HARRY EDWARD SPILLER, K.C.M.G. (1921), C.B. (1904), C.M.G. (1902).—Ed. at Cheltenham Coll. and St. John's Coll., Camb.; minor scholarship, 1889; class. tripods, 1892; passed in Hindustani and Persian, 1896; Somali, 1899; B.A., 1892; entd. Indian Army, 1894; probationer, Bombay polit. dept., as 4th astt. polit. res., Aden, Apr., 1898; astt. res., Berbera, July, 1898; vice-consul, Berbera, Oct., 1898; consul, Nov., 1902: admstd. govt. of Somaliland Prot., in 1900, 1902, 1903 and 1904; served in operations against the Somali Mullah 1902-04, as polit. offr. (ment. in depts. medal and 3 clasps); dep. comsnr., Somaliland Prot., 1904; admstd. govt., June, 1905; comsnr. and comdr-in-chief, 15th May, 1906; gov., Uganda, 1st Feb., 1910; gov., St. Helena, 22nd Nov., 1911; assumed govt., 21st Feb., 1912; gov., Bahamas, 1920.

CORNELL, C. H.—Asst. dist. comsnr., Kenya, Feb., 1921.

CORNHEY, LEONARD GEORGE.—B.A. Cantab., classical exhibtr., St. John's Coll., Camb.;
class. trip., 1908; examiner, col. audit branch of E. and A. Dept., Feb., 1910; asst. auditor, Gold Coast, Aug., 1910; ag. auditor, July, 1913, July to Dec., 1914, and Apr. to Oct., 1916; ag. asst. col. sec., Dec., 1916, to Jan., 1917; ag. senr. asst. auditor, Jan. to Apr., 1917; seconded to G. Coast Regt., 23rd Apr., 1917, to 6th Jan., 1918; ag. senr. asst. auditor, 7th Jan. to 31st Dec., 1918; senr. asst. auditor, 1st Jan., 1919; ag. auditor, Jan. to Oct., 1919; dep. audr., 1st Jan., 1920.

CORNISH-BOWDEN, ATHELSTAN HALL.—Second asst. surv.-gen., Cape Colony, 16th Jan., 1903; ag. surv.-gen., C.C., 15th Dec., 1904; apptnt., confirmed, 1st Jan., 1906; mem., joint comte., for professional exams. constituted under Univ. of S. Africa Act, 1916; trustee, Garden Cities Trust, Cape Town.

CORNWALLIS, COL. K., CM.G. (1926), C.B.E., Mily. (1919), D.S.O. (1917), Commander of the Order of King George I. of Greece, Order of Nahdhab (2nd cls.), Order of the Nile (3rd cls.), Order of Majidje (4th cls.), three times mentioned in desps.—Sudan civ. serv., 1906-14; Egyptian civ. serv., 1914; dir., Arab Bureau, Cairo, 1916-19; dep. ch. polit. offr., Egyptian Expedy. Force, 1918; asst. ch. polit. offr., ditto, 1919; attd. to Amir Feisal in London, 1919; attd. to F.O., 1920-21; accompanied Amir Feisal to Iraq and seconded to 'Iraq govt. for two years, June, 1921; adviser to min. of interior, 'Iraq, September, 1921.

CORRIE, OWEN CECIL KIRKPATRICK, M.C.—B. 1882; ed. Monckton Combe Schl. and Trinity Coll., Cambridge (maths. exhibr.); on active serv. in France, Belgium and Palestine with N. Somerset Yeomanry and R.F.A. (T.F.), 1915-19; M.C. and ment. in desps.; juv. offr., Nablus, O.E.T.A. (S.), Mar., 1919; vice-pres., ct. of appeal, O.E.T.A. (S.), Oct., 1919; vice-pres., ct. of appeal, Palestine, July, 1920; senr. Br. judge, sup. ct., Sept., 1924; ag. ch. just., Oct., 1922 to Jan., 1923 and from Oct., 1924 to Jan., 1925.

CORRY, WILFRED CHARLES STEUART.—B. 1900; ed. Cheltenham Coll. and Wadham Coll., Oxford; B.A. 1922; cadet, F.M.S., Dec., 1923; attd. secretariat, Taiping, Perak, Jan., 1924; land office, Johore Bharu, Apr., 1924; asst. collr., land rev., Johore Bharu, May, 1924; ag. 2nd asst. adviser, Batu Pahat, Feb., 1925; ag. asst. supt., govt. monopolies, Singapore and asst. contr., rubber, Singapore in addn., Aug., 1925; collr., land rev., Singapore, Oct., 1925; passed cadet, Jan., 1926.

CORSELLIS, ERNEST SHAWK, L.R.C.P.I., L.R.C.S.I., L.M. (Dub.), 1896; house surg., Jervis St. Hosp., Dublin, 1897; dist. med. offr., Cyprus, 1902; ag. ch. med. offr. on various occasions in 1912, 1917, 1918, 1920, 1921 and 1922; ch. med. offr., 24th Mar., 1922; mem., leg. coun., 1925.

CORSEK, LIMUT. E. E.—Ed. Shrewsbury; 2nd lieut., 4th Batt. King's Shropshire Light Infantry (T.), Aug., 1914; lieut., June, 1916; served in France, 1917-18; asst. dist. comsnr., G. Coast, 3rd Dec., 1919.

CORY, WILLIAM WALLACE, C.M.G. (1909).—B. 1860; entd. civ. serv., Canada, 1901; apptd. inspr. Yukon offrs., 1901; asst. comsnr., Dominion lands, 1904; dep. min. of the Interior, 1905; also comsnr. of Yukon and N.W.T., June, 1919.

COSGRAVE, ALEXANDER KIRKPATRICK, M.C.—B. 1885; ed. Shrewsbury and Trin. Coll., Dublin; B.A., M.B., B.Ch., B.A.O., 1909, D.P.H., 1918; L.M., Rot. Hosp., 1920; grad. with dist., L.S.T.M., 1920; D.T.M. & H. Lon., 1920; col. med. serv., 1910; med. offr., Ulu Selangor, 1911; on active serv., 1914-19; B.E.F. with 34th div., 1916; D.A.D.M.S., 16th (Irish) div., 1917-18; demob. with hon. rank of maj.; med. offr., Klang, ag. H.O., Coast and in charge, quarantine camp, Port Swettenham, 1920; H.O., Negri Sembilan, 1921; ag. sen. med. offr., Perak, 1921; ag. sen. health offr., F.M.S., 1922 and 1925; sen. med. offr., Selangor, 1922; ag. supt., prisons, Kuala Lumpur in addn., Apr., 1925; ag. sen. health offr., F.M.S. and malaria research offr. in addn., Sept., 1925.

COSSER, S. C. A.—B. 1880; ed. Tonbridge; clk., treasy., Transvaal, 8th May, 1901; asst. acctnt., treasy., 1st Dec., 1905; asst. acctnt., treasy., Union of S. Africa, 31st May, 1910; provincial acctnt., Transvaal Prov., 21st Nov., 1910; served in European War, 1915-19 (Gen. Serv., Victory and Mily. Meds.)

COSTRLOE, MATHEW.—B. 1866; detective sub-inspector., Trinidad, 7th June, 1911; detective-insp. of constab., 1916.

COSTLEY-WHITE, ERNEST, O.B.E. (1918).—B.A. Oxon., 1900; clk. to armed forces, B.C. Africa, Apl., 1900; asst. collr., Nyasaland Prot., Mar., 1904; 2nd grade res., Jan., 1911; transport offr. and carrier recruiting offr., Nyasaland Field Force, with temp. rank of major, 1916-18 (ment. in desps.); ag. chief sec. to gov't., May, 1919 to June, 1920; prov. comsnr., 1st June, 1921; ag. ch. sec., Oct., 1921 to Jan., 1922, and from Apr. to July, 1922; ch. sec., Zanzibar, Aug., 1922; ag. Br. res., 28th Sept. 1923 to 24th Jan., 1924 and 10th Mar. to 30th Sept., 1926.

COTCHING, HOUGHTON ALDGATE, A.M.I.Mech.E.—B. 1887; serv. in mech. dept., N.E. Ry. Coy., 1903-15; on mil. serv., 1915; seconded for duty with R.E. (inland waterways and docks), 1917; major, D.A.D.R.T. and sent to Chemin de Fer du Hedjaz as loco. supt., 1919; ch. mech. engnr., Palestine rlya., 1920.

COTTLE, HARRY ROSS.—B. 1887; supt., monotype dept., govt. printing office, Ceylon, June, 1909; ag. 3rd asst. govt. printer, in addition to his own duties, Aug., 1916, to May, 1917; on military duty, 1918; ag. govt. printer, Sept., 1919; govt. printer, Dec., 1919.

COULSON, NORMAN.—B. 1891; ed. Charterhouse and Pembroke Coll., Camb.; (M.A., hons. in cls. and mod. hist.); 2nd lieut., 10th Res. Regt., Cav., 12th Sept., 1914; attd. 8th (K.R.I.) Hussars, 20th Sept., 1915; (France and army of occupation); relinquished coman., 1st Apr., 1919; cadet F.M.S., Apr., 1920; ag. sec. to Br. adviser, Kedah, June, 1920; ag. agt., food contr., Kedah, in addn., Nov., 1920; ag. sec., sany. bd., Agar Star, in addn., Feb., 1921; passed cadet, June, 1922; attd. to treas., Penang on sp. duty, Sept., 1922; ag. dep. collr., land rev. and dep. regis. of deeds, Penang, Dec., 1922; ag. aud., Penang, Feb., 1923; dist. offr., Dindings, Apr., 1923; dist. offr., Raub, Feb., 1925; seconded for serv. in Kelantan as ag. comsnr., cust., Aug., 1926.

COUSINS, CLARENCE WILFRED.—M.A.; clk. col. sec.'s dept., Cape, 1896; dep. inspr. of prisons, 1901; prin. clk. and offr. in charge of imigr. and labour, 1905; ch. imigr. offr., 1905; prin. imigr. offr. and ch. clk. in charge of dept. of interior, Cape Town, 1913; prin. imigr. offr. and regis. of Asiatics, Pretoria, 1916; ag. of census, Union of S. Africa, 1917; sec. for 1924.

COUSINS, HERBERT HENRY, M.A., F.C.S.—Late postmr., Merton Coll., Oxford; 1st hons. nat. science, 1889; lecturer in chemistr...
S.E. Agric. Coll., Ventnor, 1894; govt. analytical and agric. chemist, Jamaica, 1900; nominated M.L.C., 1907; mem. of bd. of agric.; chemist in charge of sugar experimental statn.; author of publications on chemistry and agriculture.

COWAN, J.—Asst. traffic man., Uganda rly., Aug., 1912.

COWELL, H. RUSSELL, B.A.—B. 1877; ed. Malvern and Cambridge; scholar of Clare, 1896-9; apptd., after compet. exam., clk., sec.'s dept., inland revenue, Oct., 1901; 2nd cl. clk., C.O., 27th Mar., 1902; sec. to inter-deptm't. comttee. on oil fields of W. Indies, 1904; sec. to Roy. Com. on trade relations between Canada and W. Indies, 1909-1910; priv. sec. to Sir J. Anderson, G.C.M.G., 26th June, 1911; priv. sec. to Lord Emmott, 9th Nov., 1912; priv. sec. to Lord Islington, 8th Aug., 1914; ag. 1st cls. clk., 12th Oct., 1914; 1st cls. clk., 10th Mar., 1916; ag. prin. clk., 1st Jan., 1920; asst. sec., 1st Apr., 1920.

COWGILL, JOHN VINCENT.—B. 1888; ed. Durham Schol. and All Souls Coll., Oxford (bible-clerk, 1907-11), 3rd cls. mods., 3rd cls. lit. hum., B.A., 1911; Malayan civ. serv., 1911; studied Chinese, 1912-14; 2nd lieut., 4th battn. Sherwood Foresters, Mar., 1915; lieut., 1917; seconded to R.E. Signals, 1916; served in France with Signal Service, 1916-19; M.C., 1917; ment. in despatches, 1919; retnd. to Malaya, 1919; ag. rev. audr., Ang., 1919; ag. asst. sec. to res., Selangor, Sept., 1919; dist. offr., Temerloh, Dec., 1919; ag. prot. of Chinese, Selangor and N. Simbilan, Oct., 1920; ag. asst. prot., Chinese, Perak, Sept., 1921; ag. comsnr., cust., Johore, Dec., 1921; ag. dist. offr., Kuantan, Sept., 1923; ag. asst. adviser, Trengganu, Oct., 1923; asst. adviser Trengganu, Nov., 1923; ag. asst. adviser, Kemaman, July, 1925; town planning admstr. and state valuer, Ipoh, Feb., 1926.

COWLEY-BROWN, PATRICK CAMPBELL, M.B.E. (Civil).—B. 1896; sp. offr. in charge of locust destruction, Malacca, Aug., 1914; asst. cable censor and latterly senr. asst. cable censor, S. Stltms. and F.M.S., Nov., 1915; passport offr. and conf. clk., col. sec.'s office, Singapore, Apr., 1919 to Dec., 1921; conf. clk., col. sec.'s office, Dec., 1921.

COWPER, HERBERT WELLESLEY.—B. 1883; ed. at St. Paul's School, London, Hertford Coll., Oxford, and in Germany, France and Italy; asst. res., N. Nigeria, 30th Nov., 1910.

COX, CHARLES EDWARD LANGLETON.—B. 1889; entd. civ. serv., B. Guiana, 1907; 2nd cls. clk., col. sec.'s office; called to the bar, 1918; stip. mag. for the colony; revising barrister, 1919; prsr. dist. ct., Cyprus, 1926; served in France as lieut., R.G.A. (S.R.), injured at Loos, Sept., 1916; invalided out of army, Nov., 1917; served under Admiralty as A.T.S.O., mining depot, Grangemouth, Mar. to Dec., 1918; extra A.D.C. to Sir W. Egerton, K.C.M.G., 1913-15; lieut., artillery coy., B. Guiana Militia, 1908; capt., 1919; pol. mag., St. Vincent, 1920-23; ag. atty.-gen. and ch. just., St. Vincent; crown atty. and regist., sup. ct., Dominica, 1923-25; mem. exec. coun., income tax comsnr., off. recr., visiting just., prison, Dominica; pres., dist. ct., Cyprus, 1925.

COX, SIR CHARLES T., K.C.M.G. (1913), C.M.G. (1903).—B. 1858; Govt. sec.'s office, Br. Guiana, July, 1874; sen. clk., 1883; ch. clk. and sec. to the quarantine bd., 1888; sec. to the royal comm. on adminstr.-gen.'s dept. of Br. Guiana, 1882; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., 1899; compiled "Index to Laws of Br. Guiana," 1887 (2nd edition, 1891), also "Some Notes for Govt. Officers," 1894; asst. govt. sec., and clk. to ct. of policy and combined ct., 1889; also clk. of exec. coun., 1892; ag. govt. sec., in 1893, 1894, 1896, and 1898, with seat in exec. coun. and legislature; chmn. of comttee. on pensions, 1898; ag. audr.-gen. on several occasions; admstr. of St. Kitts and Nevis, 1899-1904; ag. gov., Leeward Is., July to Oct., 1903, and May to Sept., 1904; govt. sec. and ag. gov., B. Guiana, Sept., 1904; Apl. to Oct., 1906; Apl. to Oct., 1909, and Aug., 1911 to Apl., 1912.

COX, N. B.—Imp. customs serv., Feb., 1906; asst. to chief of customs, E. Africa Prot., Nov., 1911; dep. chief of customs, Apl., 1914; ch. of customs, Zanzibar, Feb., 1919; treas., Nov., 1922.

COX, MAJOR-GEN. SIR PERCY ZACHARIAH, G.C.M.G. (1922), G.C.I.E. (1917), K.C.S.I. (1915), K.C.M.G. (1920), K.C.I.E. (1911), C.S.I. (1909), C.I.E. (1902), F.R.G.S., F.Z.S.—B. 1864; ed. Harrow and Sandhurst; joined army 1884; served with 2nd batt. Cameronians till 1889; joined Indian Staff Corps, 1889; Indian polit. dep., 1890; vice-consul, Zaila, Somali Coast, 1893; Berbera, 1894-5; consul and polit. agt., Muscat, 1899-1904; consul-gen., Bushire, 1904; polit. res., Persian Gulf, 1909; sec., foreign dept. govt. of India, 1914; ch. polit. offr., Indian Expedy. Force "D," 1914; ment. in despatches, 1916; ag. British min. to Persia, 1919-20; high commr., Mesopotamia, 1920, ret., 1923.

COX, WILFRED BERNARD.—B. 1896; ed. Denstone Coll., Staffs.; col. audit dept., May, 1920; asst. audr., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1920.

CRABB, RICHARD BRUCE, B.L.—B. 1891; ed. Cranleigh Schol.; asst. dist. comsnr., Gold Coast 1915-16; E. Surrey Regt., 1916-19; asst. dist. comsnr., Gold Coast, 1919; dist. comsnr., 5th Aug., 1922; asst. col. sec., 8th Mar., 1923.

CRAGG, WILLIAM GILLIAT, D.S.O. (1918), Major, R. of O. Loyal Regt.—B. 1883; ed. Shrewsbury and R.M.C., Sandhurst; asst. dist. offr., N. Nigeria, 25th Aug., 1920.

CRAIG, ERNEST DUNCAN, M.A., B.Sc., F.Z.S.—B. 1888; ed. Aberdeen Univ. and at Exeter Coll., Oxford, 1900; jnr. supt. eduon. dept., N. Nigeria, 17th Jan., 1920.

CRAIG, GEORGE, LL.M. (N.Z.)—B. 1873; ed. Otago Boys' High Schol. and Victoria Univ. Coll., N.Z.; ent. N.Z. cust. dept., 1891; ch. clk., 1910; asst. comptr., 1913; comptr., 1923.

CRAIG, JOHN.—B. 1871; educ. at Glasgow and Glasgow Univ.; trained certif. teacher; principal, Boshof pub. sch., O.R.C., 1906; inspr. of schl., O.R.C., July, 1909.

CRAIG, JOHN.—B. 1884; ed. at Aberdeen Univ.; M.A., 1st cl. hons., Classics; univ. prize in Latin, 1906; and at Christ Church, Oxford; B.A., 2nd cls. hons., lit. hum., 1908; after exam., examr., E. and A. dept., 5th Jan., 1909; asst. auditor, S. Nigeria, May, 1909; temporarily transf'd to N. Nigeria, Aug., 1909; ag. local auditor, N. Nigeria, Nov.-Dec., 1909; joined col. audit dept., Jan., 1910; auditor, Br. Honduras, Nov., 1912; priv. sec. to gov., Sir W. Collett, K.C.M.G., Nov., 1914; priv. sec. and A.D.C. to ag. gov. R. Walter, C.M.G., gov. W. Hart-Bennett, C.M.G., and gov. Eyre-Hutson, C.M.G., 1915-19; lieut., B. Honduras Territorial Force; audr., Mauritius, Apr., 1920; col. audit dept., 1st Apr., 1924.

CRAIG, WM.—Supt. of mails, G.P.O., Singapore; ag. sup. money order branch and savings bank, Oct., 1903, to June, 1905; ag. asst. P.M.G.,
Singapore, Mar., 1907; supt., money order branch and govt. savings bank, Singapore, Feb., 1908; ag. astt. postmr.-gen., Singapore, June, 1909; astt. postmr.-gen., Singapore, Jan., 1912; ag. postmr.-gen., in addition, Apr., 1918; ag. postmr.-gen., June, 1919.

CRAIGIE-HALKETT, MONTAGU C.—Ag. priv. sec. to gov. Falkland Islds., Mar., 1897; writer, col. sec.'s off., Apr., 1897; priv. sec. to admstr., Apr., 1897; olk., col. sec.'s off., Oct., 1897; ag. priv. sec. to gov., Nov., 1898; treas. clk., 1899; ag. postmr., manager of savings bank, offr. administering intestate estates, as well as performing duties of regnr. sup. et., shipping master, and olk. to coun., Mar., 1908, to Apr., 1910; ag. auditor and comsrr. of currency on various occasions; ag. stip. mag., Oct., 1909; J.P., Nov., 1909; postmaster, manager of savings bank, regnr.-gen., and regnr. of supreme ct., and offl. admstr., 1911; ag. M.L.C., Feb. to Sept., 1911; supt. of census, 1911.

CRAMPTON, DUDLEY RUSSELL.—Ed. at Aldenham Schol., Elstree, and in Germany and Switzerland; astt. collr., E. Africa Prot., 24th May, 1904; dist. commr., 1909.

CRANSTON, T. D.—M.A. (Glasgow); astt. mast., training institn. for teachers, Accra, G. Coast, 17th Apr., 1912; astt. censor, in addn., 2nd Mar., 1915 to 27th Jan., 1916; ag. qtrmr., Gold Coast Volunteers, 25th Nov., 1916; lieut., ditto, 21st Apr., 1917; ag. prin., Accra Training Coll. on several occasions between 1917 and 1925; ag. prov. inspr., schls., Apr., 1926.

CRAWFORD, JOHN GERALD.—B. 1894; ed. King's schl., Chester and Merton Coll., Oxford; M.A., 1920; 2nd lieut., Cheshire Regt., T.F., Aug., 1914; lieut., Nov., 1915; capt., June, 1916; cadet, F.M.S., Mar., 1921; attd. to dist. office, Kuala Selangor, Apr., 1921; attd. to office of conserv. of forests, Jan., 1922; passed cadet, Feb., 1923; supernymy, offr., cls. V., Feb., 1922; astt. dist. offr., Batang Padang, Nov., 1923; 2nd lieut., M.V.I., Dec., 1923; ag. astt. dist. offr., Kroh, May, 1924; offr., cls. IV, Feb., 1926.

CRAWFORD, O. S.—Astt. treasur., E. Africa Prot., Dec., 1914.

CREAN, B. A.—Barrister-at-law; dep. reger. of titles, Kenya, Oct., 1920; res. mag., Apr., 1921.

CREASY, GERALD HALLEN.—B. 1897; ed. Rugby; schol., King's Coll., Camb., 1915; 2nd lieut., R.G.A., Nov., 1916; lieut., May, 1918; capt. and adjutant, Nov., 1918; served in Flanders; apptd. under reconstruction scheme astt. prin., C.O., 26th July, 1920; pvte. sec. to parl. under sec. for dominion affrs., 6th Aug., 1925.

CREASY, HAROLD THOMAS, M.Inst.C.E., A.M.I.Mech.E.—B. 1873; dist. engr., P.W.D., Colombo, 1897; Dandagamuwa, 1909; ag. provl. engr., N.C. Prov., 1909; confirmed in apptnt. as provl. engrnr., 1910; astt. dir. of pub. wks., 1913; ag. depty., D.P.W., 1913-15, and again in 1916; depty., D.P.W., 1917; ag. D.P.W., 1921 and 1923; D.P.W., Hong Kong, 1923.

CREED, HENRY.—B. 1871; apptd., after exam., 3rd class messenger in C.O., July, 1900; 2nd class, 1st Feb., 1904; King's mess., 30th Jan., 1911; office keeper, 1924.

CREMER, ARTHUR STANLEY.—B. 1886; ed. Durham schl.; col. audit dept., 23rd Jan., 1911; astt. audr., G. Coast, 1911-13; astt. audr., Nyasaland, 1913-16; astt. audr., Uganda, 1916-18; astt. audr., provisional admstr., G.E.A., 1918-19; senr. astt. audr., Tanganyika Territory, 1st Oct., 1919; audr., Mauritius, 8th July, 1924.

CREMER, JOHN AWDRY.—B. 1881; B.A. (Oron.), 1903; olk., col. audit branch, E. and A.D., 1903; astt. auditor, Lagos, 1905; astt. auditor, Nyasaland, 1908; 2nd cls. olk., cent. office, 1913; auditor, Nyasaland, 1914; audr., Cyprus, Sept., 1926.

CRESSALL, PAUL EWART FRANCIS, M.C.—B. 1893; ed. Cranleigh Schol.; ent. civ. serv., B. Guiana, 1911; cler. astt., secretariat and sub-inspr., B. Guiana pol., 1912; ag. dist. inspr., 1914-15; 2nd lieut., B. Guiana Militia Infy., 1914; served in B.W.I. Regt. as capt., E. Africa and Palestine, 1915-19; dist. inspr., B. Guiana pol., 1920; ag. county inspr., 1920; passed final law exam., 1921; capt., B. Guiana local forces, 1922; ag. staff offr., B. Guiana local forces, 1922; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1923; county inspr., pol., 1923; stip. mag., Apr., 1924; ag. stip. mag., Georgetown, Aug., 1924 to Dec., 1924 and July to Dec., 1926; chmn., comm. of enquiry into Onderneeming industrial schl., Sept., 1925; ag. chmn., soldiers' pensions bd., 1925; chmn., ditto, Nov., 1926.

CRESWELL, COL. THE HON. FREDERIC HUGH PAGE, D.S.O.—B. 1866; ed. Bruce Castle, Derby Schol., and R. Schol. of Mines (grad. 1st cls.); arrived in S. Africa, May, 1893; mining in Rhodesia, 1893-94; man., Durban Roodpoort Deep Mine, 1895-99; served in Imp. Light Horse during Anglo-Boer war; man., Village Main Reef, 1902-03; supported agitation for expulsion of Chinese labour; elec. to first Union parl., 1910, and led Labour Party; 2nd in commd., Rand Rifles, S. W. Africa, 1914; 2nd in commd., subsequently commmdg., 8th S. A. Infy. Brig., German E. Africa campaign; defeated in 1921 elec. but retd. at by-elec., July, 1922; min. of defence and labour, Hertzog cabinet, 30th June, 1924; min. of defence, 12th Nov., 1925.

CRESWELL, Rear-Admiral Sir William Rooke, K.C.M.G. (1911), K.B.E. (1919), C.M.G. (1897).—Joined R.N., Dec., 1865; lieut., 1873, for service in action at Laroot River (wounded); engaged in suppression of slave trade on African coast, 1875-7; ret. from Navy, 1878; apptd. to S. Australian naval force, 1885; comdr., 1891; post. capt., 1895; naval comdt., 1893-1900; commanded H.M.C.S. "Protector" to China during Boxer outbreak, 1900; naval comdt. of Queensland, 1900-4; dir. of commonwealth naval forces, 1904; attended Imp. Conf. on naval and mil. defense, 1909; rear-admiral, 1911; retired, 1919.

CREWE, 1st MARQUESS OF (or. 1911); ROBERT OFFLEY ASHBURTON CREWE-MILNES, K.G., P.C., M.A., F.S.A.—B. 1858; Baron Houghton of Great Houghton in the county of York, 1863; Earl of Crewe (or. 1895); Earl of Madeley (or. 1911); ed. at Harrow and Trin. Coll., Camb.; astt. priv. sec. to sec. for foreign affairs (Earl Granville), 1883-84; lord-in-waiting to Queen Victoria, 1886; lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1892-95; lord pres. of the coun., 1905-08; S. of S. for the Colonies, Apr., 1908; Lord Privy Seal (in conjunction with Secretaryship of State), 1908; S. of S. for India, 1910-15; accompanied H.M. King George V. on the occasion of the Royal visit to India, 1911; lord pres. of the coun., 1915.

CREWE, BRIG.-GEN. THE HON. SIR CHARLES PRESTON, K.C.M.G. (1915), C.B. (1900).—B. 1855; served in Cape M.R., 1878-81; M.L.A. for E. Griqualand, 1899; M.L.A. for Aliwal North and col. sec., Feb., 1904, to June, 1907; sec. for agric., June, 1907; raised and was major commanding Border Horse Regt., 1900; promoted to lieut.-col., May, 1909; colonel, 1901; in command of western div. of Cape, Nov., 1901, to termination of
hostilities; ret. from Cape Colony forces, 31st Dec., 1902; sec. for agric., June, 1907, to Feb., 1908; M.L.A., East London, 1908; mem. for East London in Union parl., 1910 to 1918.

CREWE-READ, E. C.—Aast. dist. comsnr., E.A.P., 5th Jan., 1907; ag. dist. comsnr., Apl., 1913; senr. comsnr. (2nd cls.), Jan., 1925.

CRICHLLOW, NATHANIEL.—M.B., Ch.B.; med. offr., Solomon Islands, Oct., 1914.

CRICHTON, REGINALD, M.A.—B. 1877; educ. privately and at Univ. Coll., Oxford; cadet, Perak, F.M.S., Nov., 1900; passed in Malay, May, 1902; passed in law, Oct., 1902; ag. asst. dist. mag., Kuala Kangsar, 30th May, 1901; ditto, Brus, 23rd Oct., 1902; ag. asst. dist. offr., Gopeng, 21st Feb., 1903; ag. 2nd mag., Kuala Lumpur, 16th Sept., 1904; ag. asst. registr., sup. ct., Ipoh, 16th Mar., 1906; dist. treasur., Raub, 1st Aug., 1906; state treas., Pahang, 1st July, 1907; ag. regiar., sup. ct., 29th Jan., 1908 to 31st Oct., 1911; dist. offr., Kuantan, 24th Mar., 1908; asst. dist. offr., Kuantan, 5th June, 1908; ag. regiar. of sup. ct., 25th Nov., 1911; offr. of cls. IV., 1st Jan., 1912; asst. adviser to govt. of Johore at Muar (seconded), 26th Apr., 1913; ag. 2nd asst. col. sec., S. Stiltns., 9th Feb., 1915; offr. of cls. III., 1st Jan., 1918; cls. II., 1st Jan., 1919; dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, 7th Mar., 1920; dist. offr., Larut and Matang, 23rd June, 1923; dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, 11th July, 1923; ag. dist. offr., Klang, cls. I., B. 21st Oct., 1925; ag. comsnr., trade and cust., F.M.S., cls. I.A., 12th Apr., 1926.

CRITTIEN, ATILIO, M.B.E. (1919), M.A., M.D., Malta Univ., D.P.H., D.T.M. (Liverpool), 1906.—B. 1872; demonstr. schl. of anatomy, 1899 to 1901; civil surgeon attchd. R.A.M.C., 1901 to 1904; med. offr. of hith., Malta, 1906 to 1917; chief govt. med. offr. and supt. of pub. hith., with seat in exec. coun. and coun. of govt., 1917.

CROFTON, RICHARD HAYES.—B. 1880; ed. St. John's Coll., Camb.; B.A. class, tripods, 1901; fellow, Royal Economic Socy.; assoc., Town Planning Inst.; clk., coll. audt branch, E. and A. dept., 1st July, 1901; clk., audt dept., Hong Kong, 26th Aug., 1903; ag. local auditor, 14th Feb. to 22nd Dec., 1904; ch. clk., coll. sec. off., 11th Mar., 1905; ag. asst. col. sec., and clk. of couns., for periods in 1907, 1911, 1912, 1913; asst. chief sec., Zanzibar, 6th Feb., 1914; ag. chief sec. for various periods, 1914-18, 1922-24 and in 1926; ag. sec., admin., Tanganyika Terry., Dec., 1919 to Mar., 1920; ag. treas., Zanzibar, for various periods, 1920-22; mem., educn. comsn., 1920; chmn., comsn. on agr., 1923; chmn., museum organising comtee., 1924; publications, "Statistics of the Zanzibar Prot., 1893-1920," "Adventures in Administration."

CROOK, ALFRED H., B.A.—Ed. at Wesley Coll., Dublin; honorman and gold medallist, Trin. Coll., Dublin; M.A., 1908; F.R.G.S.; ast. mast., Wesley Coll., Dublin; junr. ast. mast., Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, 1902; senr. ast., 1908; lecturer in biology, Hong Kong Coll. of Med., 1903-1912; ag. 2nd mast., 1914 to 1916; ag. headmast., 1915; headmast., Yaumati govt. schl., 1917; Queen's Coll., Mar., 1926.

CROOK, JOHN ROWLAND, O.B.E. (1919), M.I.C.E.—B. 1866; entered Crystal Pal. Engrng. Sch., 1881; ast. to E. F. Griffith, C.E. (consulting sanitary engrn.), 1883; supt. of drawing office, C. P. Engrng. Sch., 1883; awarded 1st prize for civ. engrn., City of Lon. Coll., 1889; ast. engrn. water and drainage dept., Hong Kong, 1891-92; exec. engrn., P.W.D., with control of sewerage and water works, 1893-1900; in charge of roads and telephones, 1897; survr. to sanitary bd., 1892-1900; reed. thanks of govt. and S. of S. for services during plague, 1904; govt. engrn., Gibraltar, 1900; took over crown lands dept., 1903; offr. for rates and expenses local revenue, 1907; san. comsnr., 1919; ag. inspr. of schls., 1919; chief ast. and cable censor, 1914-19; local priority authority (Ministry of Munitions), 1917-19.

CROSBIE, HON. SIR JOHN C., K.B.E. (1919).—M.H.A., Bay de Verde dist., Newfoundland, 1908; M.E.C., 1909; mem. defence comtee., 1915; chmn., tonnage comtee., 1917; min. of militia, 1917; min. of shipping, 1918.

CROSBIE, ROBERT EDWARD HAROLD.—B. 1896; ed. Cheltenham and Pembroke Coll., Cambridge (schol.); B.A. (class. tripods, hons. cls. II), 1908; Egyptian civ. serv., 1910-19; seconded for mily. serv. with E.E.F., 1915; apptd. to O.E.T.A. (S.), 1918; dep. mily. gov., Brisban, 1919; dep. mily. gov., Tiberias, 1920; dep. dist. gov., Jenin, 1920; ast. gov. (continuing as ast. dist. comsnr.), S. dist., 1922; passed advanced Arabic exam., 1924.

CUBITT, GEORGE EATON STANNARD.—B. 1874; ed. Ipswich Schol. and Royal Indian Engrng. Coll., Cooper's Hill; ast. const., Indian forest serv., Burma, 4th Dec., 1896; dep. const., 29th Nov., 1902; ast. inspr.-gen., forests, Simla, 1st Aug., 1912; on deputation to S.S. and F.M.S. as conar. forests, 1st Apr., 1915; ret. from Ind. serv. and confirmed as const., forests, S.S. and F.M.S., 1st Apr., 1920; on tour to Canada representing Malaya at Br. Empire Forestry Conf., June to Oct., 1923; mem., selection bd. for forestry probationers, June, 1925.

CUFF, CYRIL CHARLES HERBERT, M.B., B.S. (Durham), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), F.R.C.S. (Edin.).—B. 1888; lieut., R.N.V.R., 1914; passed Bd. of Trade exam. for master, 1916; transf. to R.A.M.C., 1918; res. surg. and bacteriologist, St. Lucia, 1921-23; resigned; ret. col. serv. and apptd. to Seychelles as sen. ast. med. offr., res. surg. and visiting mag., outlying islda., 1924; ag. ch. med. offr., June to Nov., 1924; dist. med. offr., Cyprus, Sept., 1926.

CULLEN, HON. SIR WM. PORTUS, K.C.M.G. (1912), KT. BACH. (1911), K.C., M.A., LL.D.—Barrister-at-law; M.L.A., New South Wales, July, 1891; M.L.C., Aug., 1895; fellow of Senate of Sydney Univ. since 1896; vice-chancellor, 1908; resigned from legis. coun. and apptd. chief just. of N.S.W., Jan., 1910; lieut. gov., N.S.W., 30th Mar., 1910; ret., 1926; chancellor of Sydney Univ. from Sept. 1914.

CULEIGAN, HON. ARTHUR.—B. 1879; lumberman and farmer; elected to legis. assem. New Brunswick, 1912; min. without portfolio in Murray admstr., 1917.

CULMER, J. J., M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.).—B. 1866; ast. surgeon, New Providence asylum, 1898; res. surg.-supt., ditto, 1905; res. surg., gen., Bahamas, 1911; M.H.A., Bahamas, 1911-18; ag. ch. med. offr. for various periods between 1911 and 1923; lieut., Bahamas Vol. Defence Force, 1917; mem., bd. of comsrs., Bahamas gen. hosp., 1918; mem., venereal diseases comsn., 1918; sp. certif. roentgenology, New York post grad. hosp., 1919; mem. discharged soldiers comsn., 1919; introduced X-rays in Bahamas, 1920; mem., bd. to examine med. and dental practitioners in the Bahamas, 1923; mem., B.M.A., 1924.

CULMER, J. S.—B. 1868; entd. Bahamas civ. serv., 1894; Out Island comsnr. (3rd div.), 1909; (2nd div.), 1914.
CURLEWIS, Herbert Rainke, B.A., LL.B.—Judge of industrial arbitn. ct., New S. Wales, 1917-26.

CURLEWIS, John Stephen, B.A., LL.B. (Cape).—Cape civ. serv., 1883-1888; advocate, sup. ct., Cape Colony, 12th Oct., 1887; advocate, high ct. (late S.A.R.), May, 1888; counsel for Imperial govt. in arbitn. with late S.A.R. re Asiatic question, 1895; ag. judge of high ct. (late S.A.R.), 15th Apr., 1899 to 31st Jan., 1900; pres. of crim. ct. for Witwatersrand, 2nd Nov., 1899 to 31st Jan., 1900; puisne judge, sup. ct., Transvaal, 1st Sept., 1903; puisne judge, sup. ct. of S. Africa (Transvaal Prov. Div.), 31st May, 1910; judge pres., July, 1924.

CURMI, TANCRED, M.V.O. (1907).—Ast. supt. of pol., Malta, 1890; sen. ast., 1902; supt., 1903; ret., Sept., 1916.

CURRY, H. D.—B. 1893; ed. Dulwich coll.; served in Fiji, 1911-18; ag. 2nd cls. clk., C.S.O., 1915; cadet, Solomon Islands, 1918; ag. dist. offr., Gizo, 1915; on milly. serv., 1917-19; 2nd lieut., 1919; priv. sec. to gov. of B. Honduras, 1919; resumed duty Solomon Is., 1920; ag. dist. offr., Shortlands, 1920; ag. sec., 1920; admin. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 9th Feb., 1923.

CUSACK, Capt. Henry Vernon (Res. of Offrs.).—B. 1895; ed. Aravon Schl. and Royal Coll. of Sci., Ireland; served in European War, Flanders and N. Russia, 1915-19; ast. audr., Sierra Leone, July, 1920; ag. audr., Oct.-Nov., 1921; ast. audr., Nigeria, Oct., 1922.

CUSCADEN, George Percy.—B. 1883; ed. Conig Schl., Dublin; attd. to Roy. Irish Constab., Nov., 1902 to Aug., 1903; ag. ast. supt., pol., S. Stltnts., Dec., 1903; ast. comanr., pol., F.M.S., May, 1904; ag. dist. supt. of prisons, N. Sembilan, in addn. ch. pol. offr., May-June, 1907; ag. adjt., pol. depot, Apr.-Aug., 1908; comanr., pol., Johore, and pub. pros. in addn., Apr., 1912, to Apr., 1913; comanr. of pol., Johore, 1st July, 1915; offr. commdg., Johore Vol. Rifles, Sept., 1915, to Aug., 1916; dep. comanr., pol., F.M.S., 1st Jan., 1919; dep. comanr., pol., Selangor, July, 1920.

CUSSSEN, Sir Leo Finn Bernard, K.T. Bach. (1922)—B. 1859; judge of sup. ct., Victoria, since Mar., 1906.

CUSSSEN, Richard Cecil.—B. 1887; B.A., Dublin; cadet, F.M.S., 1911; ag. dist. offr., Jelebu, 1912; ag. ast. colr., land rev., Seremban, 1913; ag. ast. dist. offr., Lipis, 1913; ag. ast. dist. offr., Kuala Kubu, 1914; ast. dist. offr. Batang Padang, 1915; ast. dist. offr., Kroh, 1916; ast. dist. offr., Raub, 1917 and 1920; ag. dist. offr., Dindinga, 1918; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, 1919; mag., Seremban and ast. regir., sup. ct., 1920; ag. dep. commr., trade and cust., F.M.S., 1923; ag. dep. pub. pros., Perak, Nov., 1923; ag. offl. assignee and pub. trustee, F.M.S., July, 1925; ag. dep. legal adviser, F.M.S., in addn., Jan., 1926.

CUTFIELD, A. J.—Cadet, Sarawak civ. serv., Dec., 1904; ast. res., Jan., 1907; 2nd cls. res., June, 1908; resig., Dec., 1908; ast. dist. comanr., G. Coast, 3rd Aug., 1910; attd., col. sec.'s office, 1912-13; dist. comanr., Ashanti, 27th Jan., 1915; ag. prov. comanr., S. Prov., Ashanti, 22nd June to 22nd Aug., 1916; dist. comanr., N. Territories, 9th March, 1917 to 18th Jan., 1920; senr. ast. col. sec., 20th Nov., 1920; clk. of couna., 6th Feb., 1921; ag. ch. ast. col. sec., 1st Feb. to 10th Mar., 1921; dep. prov. comanr., N. Territories, 1921.

CUTHBERT, MONSON.—Ed. Edin. Instit. and Glasgow and West of Scot. Tech. Coll.; apprent. engrn. to Messrs. Dick, Kerr and Co., Ltd., London, 1895; electrn. with Glasgow corptn. elec. dept., 1899; ast. engrn. Govan corptn. elec. dept., 1901; chief ast. engrn. Oban corptn. elec. dept., 1904; electrn. engrn., B. Honduras, 1905; exec. and electrn. engrn., P.W.D., B. Honduras, 1909; lieut., B.H.T.F., 1917; ag. adjt., B.H.T.F., Aug., 1917 to Jan., 1918; hon. A.D.C. to gov., B. Honduras, 1919.

CUTLER, Thomas Robert.—B. 1870; entered civ. ser., Trinidad, 1st Jan., 1909; ast. colr. of customs, 16th Dec., 1909; collr. of cust., 1924.

CUTTERIDGE, J. O., A.C.P., F.R.G.S.—B. 1887; ed. Borough Road Coll., Ilseworth, London, 1906-08; teacher's certif. (with 4 distinctions) Bd. of Educn., Lond.; A.C.T.cert., Bd. of Educn., Lond.; staff-capt., H.M. Forces; inspr., Q.M.G. services; maths. and drawing master, Junr. Tech. Schl., Liverpool, 1919; prin., govt. training coll., Trinidad, Jan., 1921; mem., Inter.-Col. Educn. Confce, 1921; mem. bd. indust. training; supt., tech. classes, 1922; ag. senr. inspr. schl., Feb., 1923; senr. inspr. schl., Trinidad, 1st July, 1923; ag. dir., educn., July, 1925 to Mar., 1926; ast. dir., educon. and senr. inspr., schl., June, 1926.

CUZEN, Allan Leckie.—Served in R.E., 1901-2; S. African War (medal and five clasps); Cape police, 1902-6; Bech. Prot. police, 1906-14; passed Cape civ. serv. lower law exam., 1914; 2nd clk. to ast. comanr., N. Dist., Bech. Prot., 1914; ag. ast. res. mag., ditto, 1915; passed 2nd grade Seowana exam., 1916; ag. res. mag., 1917; ag. ast. res. mag., 1919; res. mag., 1921.

DABNER, Charles J.—B. 1876; on milly. serv., France and Flanders, Sept., 1914 to Mar., 1919; clk., Army pay office, Engnr., Mar. to Oct., 1919; clk., Army pay office, command paymr., Overseas Bases, Oct., 1919 to July, 1923; cler. offr., C.O., 10th July, 1922.

DAKERS, Colin Hugh.—B. 1897; ed., Manchester Gram. Schl. (class. side) till 1915; temp. 2nd lieut., 15th (S.) Bn. The Royal Scots, 10th Aug., 1915; went to France to 15th R.S., 16th June, 1916; M.C., 19th July, 1917; sent to North Russia, Archangel Prov., with 2/10th Royal Scoa., 16th Aug., 1918; attd., 2nd Battn., The Royal Scoats till disembodied with the rank of Captain, 11th Oct., 1919; cadet, F.M.S., 20th Nov., 1920; left to study Chinese in Canton, July, 1921; passed final Chinese exam., Aug., 1923; ag. ast. prot. Chinese, Singapore, Sept., 1923; ag. ast. prot. Chinese, Perak, Oct., 1923; offl., cls. V, Nov., 1923; inspr., liquor shops, F.M.S., Sept., 1925.

DALLAS, Francis Henry.—Ed. Univ. Coll. School; ast. sec. Penang municipality, 1895; ag. sec., May, 1896; Sarawak civ. ser.; ag. editor Sarawak Gazette, and manager, Sarawak govt. printing office, 1897; ag. treas. and clk., supreme coun., June, 1902; treas. and recorder of sup. coun., 1903; mem. of comtee. of adminstr., 1903-4.

DALLIN, Thomas.—Late lieut. 3rd Batt Essex Regt.; served in S. African War (medal and two clasps); hon. 2nd lieut. in the army, 6th Oct., 1902; joined col. audit dept., 22nd Feb., 1904; examr., exchequer and audit dept., 1st July, 1906; ast. auditor, S. Nigeria, 6th Oct., 1906, to 15th Feb., 1910; reverted to ex. and audit dept., 16th Feb., 1910; ast. auditor, Hong Kong, 30th July, 1910; ag. auditor, 22nd July to 15th Sept., 1911, 22nd Aug. to 13th Nov., 1912, 1st June to 28th Oct., 1913, 5th June to 13th Sept., 1914; ast. cable censor, Aug.-Oct., 1914; on mil. serv., 7th Mar., 1916 to 13th July,
DOMINIONS OFFICE AND COLONIAL OFFICE LIST.

1916; ag. audr., 18th Aug., 1916 to 8th Dec., 1917; J.P., 1918; attd. to finan. branch, W.O., Sept., 1918 to Mar., 1919; ag. audr. on various occasions in 1920, 1923, 1924, 1925 and 1926.

DALTON, THE REV. JOHN NEALE, M.A., K.C.V.O. (1911). C.M.G. (1882).—B. 1839; was gov. to T.R.H. Princes Albert Victor and George of Wales, and ag. chaplain to H.M.S. "Bacchante"; chaplain in ord. to Her Majesty, 1886; canon of Windsor, 1886.

DALTON, LLWELYN CHISHOLM.—B. 1879; ed. Marlborough and Trin. Coll., Camb.; B.A., 1900 (Hist. Tripes); M.A., 1905; called to the bar Gray's Inn, 1901; legal asst., land settm. bd., O.R.C., Oct., 1901; astt. res. mag. and J.P., June, 1902 to Nov., 1910; advoc., sup. ct., 1904; registr., B. Guiana, Nov., 1910; judge advoc., local forces, 1914; ag. puisne judge, Nov., 1912 to Feb., 1913; Nov., 1914 to Jan., 1915; July, 1916, to June, 1917; July to Sept., 1918; Mar. to June, 1919; ag. solr.-gen., May to Aug., 1914; Sept., 1914 to Jan., 1915; ag. atty-gen., Aug.-Sept., 1914; Feb.-Apl., 1918; ag. chief just., July-Sept., 1917; June-Oct., 1919; puisne judge, B. Guiana, June, 1919; puisne judge, Gold Coast, Feb., 1923; puisne judge, Ceylon, Mar., 1925; compiled and edited "Statutory Rules and Orders (B. Guiana)," to 1914, 2 vols.; editor, B. Guiana Law Reports, 9 vols.; an astt. editor "Burge on Colonial and Foreign Laws," 2nd edit., vol. iv.; compiled Digest of Case Law of British Guiana, 1910-1920; author of "Civil Law of British Guiana."

DALY, MAURICE DOMINIC.—B. 1875; ed. Downside Coll. and London Univ.; barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1920; cadet, F.M.S., 1st Dec., 1898; passed in Malay and Siamese; passed cadet, May, 1901; ag. dist. offr., Kuala Pilah, Oct., 1901; astt. dist. offr., Pekan, Mar., 1902; ag. dist. offr., Kuantan, Sept., 1903; offr., cls. VI., Jan., 1903; cls. V., Jan., 1906; ag. astt. dist. offr., Ipoh, July, 1906; ag. mag.-Seremban, July, 1907; ag. dist. offr., Raub, Sept., 1908; ag. mag., Kuala Lumpur, Feb., 1911; offr., cls. IV., Feb., 1911; astt. sec. to ch. sec., cont. to act as mag., Kuala Lumpur, Feb., 1911; ag. ch. astt. dist. offr., Kinta, June, 1913; ch. astt. dist. offr., cls. III., Kinta, Dec., 1913; dist. offr., Krian, Apr., 1918; dep. pub. pros., Perak, July, 1918; offr., cls. II., Jan., 1919; dep. pub. pros., F.M.S., Feb., 1919; ag. comsnr., trade and cust., F.M.S., as offr., cls. I.A., Apr., 1921; supernumy. offr., cls. I., grade B, July, 1922; legal adviser and judge, Kedah, Nov., 1922; ag. comsnr., lands, F.M.S., May, 1926.

DALZIEL, JOHN McEWEN, M.B.C.M. (Edin.), 1895; M.D. (Edin.), 1903.—certif. in Trop. Diseases (Edin.), 1903; B.Sc. Pub. Health (Edin.) 1904; diploma Trop. Med. (Liverpool), 1904; F.L.S.; in China from 1895 to 1902; joined W.A.M.S., 14th Jan., 1905; sen. sanitary offr., G. Coast, 28th Dec., 1918; author of "A Hausa Botanical Vocabulary" (Fisher Unwin), 1916.

DANDRIA, HON. REV. ENRICO, B.L. Can., D.D., Ph.D.—B. 1892; ed. St. Paul's Inst., Valletta; matric. Malta Univ., 1906; B.L. Can., D.D., 1913; awarded govt. prize as first student of academical course; Ph.D., Gregorian Univ., Rome, 1915; teacher of philosophy and English lit. and prefect of studies in Archiiepiscopal Seminary, Malta, 1916-19; elec. for 2nd divn. in Maltese parlmt., Oct., 1921; min. for pub. instrn., 10th July, 1923.

DANDURAND, HON. RAOUl, K.C., LL.D.—B. 1861; advocate Q.C., 1897; Knight of Legion of Honour, 1891; offr., 1907; comdr., 1912; called to Senate of Can., 1898; min. without portfolio in King admntr., 1921; govt. leader in Senate; pres., assembly, League of Nations, 1926.

DANIEL, REGINALD YOUNG, M.A. (Oxon).—B.1894; on milly. serv., Sept., 1914; cadet, Ceylon, Oct., 1920; attd. to Galle Kachcheri, Oct., 1920; ag. office asst. to astt. govt. agt., Matara, Sept., 1921; ag. pol. mag., Galle, Jan., 1922; ag. office asst. to astt. govt. agt., Hambantota, Mar., 1922; ditto to govt. agt., N. Prov., Nov., 1922; dist. judge, Anuradhapura, Dec., 1925.

DANIEL, ROWLAND MORTIMER.—B. 1873; ed. at St. Edmund's, Canterbury; 2nd lieut. Glam. Artil. Militia, 1893; certif. of Musk., Hythe; capt. and instr. of gunnery, 1898; sub. inspr., BechuanaLand Prot. divn., B.S.A. pol., 1898; inspr., 1901; served through the S. African war, 1899 to 1902, including the siege of Mafeking; mentd. in desps.; brig. signalling offr. and staff-capt., 1900-1901; astt. res. mag., Serowe, 1903; astt. comsnr. for Northern Dist. Bech. Prot. 1907; served through European War, 1914-18, mentd. in desp.; ag. govt. sec., Dec., 1920 to May, 1921; passed Cape civ. ser. lower law exam., 1907; passed 3rd grade, Sechuana language, 1911; on sp. duty, N'gamiland and Ghanzi, June to Sept., 1923; astt. res. comsnr., Bech. Prot., 12th Nov., 1923; ag. res. comsnr., 1926.

DARNLEY, E. R.—B. 1876; scholar of Trin. Coll., Camb., 1893; of Lond. Univ., 1897; B.A. (sixth wrangler) and B.Sc., 1897; M.A., 1923; apptd., after compet. exam., 2nd class clk., C.O., 11th Oct., 1898; astt. priv. sec. to Earl of Elgin, Jan., 1907; sec. to finance comtee., Jan., 1908; 1st cls. clk., 30th June, 1909; ag. prin. clk., 4th Jan., 1919; sec. col. research comtee., 1919; prin. clk., 1st Jan., 1920; astt. sec., 1st Apr., 1920; chmn., "Discovery" comtee., 1923.

DARRELL, ARTHUR LLERWLLYN.—B. 1883; ed. at Harrison Coll., Barbados, and gram. schl. St. Vincent; astt. clk. to regsr., St. Vincent, 1900-01; also performed duties as clk. to mag. 1st dist. court; 3rd clk., treas., 1901-03; 2nd landing waiter, customs, 1903; ag. 1st landing waiter, 1903; acted as audit clk. on several occasions, 1904, 1905, 1906-08; ag. clk. to regsr., 1904; ag. trav. audit clk., Windward Is., 1909; 2nd clk. to gov., Windward Is. (Grenada), 1909.

DAVENPORT, CAPT. C. T., R.A., (Oxon).—Astt. dist. comsnr., Kenya, Jan., 1920.

DAVIEy, JOHN ALEXANDER.—Cape tel. serv., 27th Apr., 1892; sub. inspr., 1st Oct., 1894; 2nd cls. survr. clk. and astt. inspr., 1st Jan., 1899; 1st cls. ditto, 1st July, 1904; survr. and dist. engr., Eastern distr., 1st Apr., 1912; Natal dist., 1st Mar., 1917; survr., 1st grade ditto, 25th Jan., 1918; survr., 1st grade, Transvaal, 1st Apr., 1920; postmr., Johannesburg, 1st Apr., 1922; astt.-sec., 1st Nov., 1923; astt. P.M.C., 1926.

DAVID, PAUL AUGUST FELIX, B.A., Oxon.—Cadet, F.M.S., Dec., 1896; astt. dist. offr. and treas., Kuala Lumpur, Perak, Dec., 1900; 2nd astt. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Perak, Jan., 1903; dist. offr., Temerloh, Pahang, Mar., 1904; ditto, Christmas Is., May, 1907; ag. dep. regsr., Penang, May, 1909; 2nd astt. prot. of Chinese, and ag. offl. assignee, Singapore, Feb., 1910; promoted to cls. III., May, 1911; ag. 2nd mag., Singapore, June, 1912; ag. astt. col. sec., and clk. of couns., July, 1912; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, Sept., 1913, ag. offl. assignee, Singapore, Oct., 1913; ag. sec., high comsnr., F.M.S., and priv. sec., Apr., 1914; ag. auditor-gen., July, 1914;
censor, Singapore, Mar., 1915; ag. sec., high comsnr., F.M.S., Mar. to May, 1917; war services recog. by sec. of state, Apr., 1918; ag. 2nd mag., May, 1918; ag. dist. judge, May, 1918; offr. asst. col. sec. and clk. of couns., Mar., 1919; ag. dist. judge, June, 1919; ag. regis. of companies and offi. assignee, Nov., 1920; ag. dist. judge and 1st mag., Singapore, 13th Mar., 1922.

DAVIDSON, EDWARD ERNEST.—B. 1878; extra clk., C.S.O., Ceylon, 16th July, 1898; inspr. of post offices, Jan., 1900; office astt. to dir. of public instruction, Jan., 1900; ag. inspr. of schls, Apr., 1911, and May, 1912; apptd. to cls. V. of civ. serv. Jan., 1913; ag. astt. dir. of educn., Apr., 1920; addnl. astt. dir. of educn., Oct., 1920; office astt. to dir., educn., Nov., 1922.

DAVIDSON, GERALD LAROON DEAN.—B. 1898; on mily. serv., Sept., 1917; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1921; astt., Colombo kachcheri, Dec., 1921; astt., Badulla kachcheri, Jan., 1922; office astt., Ratnapura kach., Oct., 1924; ditto, Kurunegala kach., Oct., 1926.

DAVIDSON, J. C.—B. 1876; ed. Robert Gordon's Coll., Aberdeen; inspr., weights and measures, Aberdeen Corporation; town assizer, Johannesburg, Transvaal, 1903; supt. of assize, dept. of mines and industries, Union of S. Africa, 1923.

DAVIDSON, P.—Clk. treasy., Cape, Sept., 1888; astt. acctnt., Nov., 1903; ch. clk., income tax office, Aug., 1904; offr. i/o advances to co-operative societies, July, 1906; ch. assessor, income tax, Sept., 1908; dep. comsnr., income tax, July, 1910; astt. dir. of census, May, 1911; prin. clk., irrgtn. dept., Jan., 1912; dep. comsnr., income tax, Aug., 1914; inspr., inland rev. dept., Nov., 1916; reor. of rev., Durban, 1st Mar., 1921.

DAVIDSON - HOUSTON, Lieut.-Col. WILFRED B., C.M.G. (1911).—Ed. at Corrig schl., Ireland, and St. Edward's, Oxford; 2nd lieut. 5th Royal Dublin Fus., Jan., 1887; capt., 1892; major, 1902; lieut.-col., 1906; B.S.A. Co. pol. and astt. comsnr., Rhodesia, 1890-92; certificates, R.I.C. and Dublin met. pol., 1895; astt. inspr., G. Coast Constaby. (Hausa), Jan., 1894; inspr., Jan., 1898; capt., W.A.F.F., Jan., 1898; on spec. serv. Kwahu and Ashanti-Akim, Feb., 1894, to Mar., 1895; Ashanti expdn., 1895-6, commanded advanced guard, main column (hon. ment. in desp., star); spec. miss. to N.W. Ashanti, Feb. to May, 1896; with Hausa detach. in London, Jubilee, 1897 (medal); operations in N. T., G. Coast, 1897-8 (medal and clasp); ag. res., Ashanti, May, 1899, to Apr., 1900; Ashanti campaign, 1900 (medal and clasp); S. African War, 1901-2, staff offr., Warrenton (medal and 5 clasps); European war, 1914-18: Br. War and Victory medals; adjutant 5th Roy. Dub. Fus., 1902; comsnr. of Ashanti, 1902; ag. ch. comsnr. of Ashanti, Mar. to May, 1903; and from July, 1904, to Mar., 1905; comsnr. of Montserrat, 25th Apr., 1906; assumed govt., 4th May, 1906; mem. gen. leg. and federal exec. couns., Leeward Is., 1906; Leeward Is. deleg. to Impl. educn. confce., 1911; staff offr., colonial coronation contingent, 1911 (medal); deleg. to Canada, West Indies reciprocity confce, at Ottawa, 1912; D.A.Q.M.G., Central Force, 1915; Eastern command, 1916; headqrs., 1st Army, B.E.F., 1917; deputy controller of labour, France, 1918; adminstr. and col. sec., St. Lucia, 27th Nov., 1918; assumed govt., 21st Dec., 1918; ag. gov., Windward Is., March, 1923 and from 2nd Nov., 1923 to May, 1924.

DAVIES, D. E.—B. 1889; ed. at Llandovery and Worcester Coll., Oxon.; astt. dist. comsnr., Gold Coast, Apr., 1915; junr. astt. col. sec., May-July, 1915; ag. dist. comsnr., Addah, July, 1915 to May, 1916; ag. dist. comsnr., Accra, Sep., 1916 to Sep., 1917.

DAVIES, EDWARD HAROLD.—B. 1895; on mily. serv., Aug., 1914; cadet, Ceylon, Oct., 1920; astt. to Kandy Kachcheri, Nov., 1920; ag. pol. mag., Matara, Jan., 1922; ditto Panadura, May, 1922; office astt. to govt. agt., Prov. of Uva, Oct., 1922; ag. pol. mag., Negombo, Feb., 1924; astt. dir., statistics, Mar., 1924; dep. fiscal, Colombo in addn., May, 1924; off. astt., Kandy kach., Oct., 1926.

DAVIES, HENRY NOEL, O.B.E., M.Inst.T.—B. 1881; astt. audr., S. Indian rly., 1900-17; ag. dep. ch. audr., 1916-17; major, Rly. Corps, German E. Africa, 1917-19; ch. acct., Tanganyika rly., Apr., 1919.

DAVIES, RICHARD MORGAN.—B. 1892; on mily. serv., Dec., 1914; cadet, Ceylon, Sept., 1920; astt. to Puttalam Kachcheri, Oct., 1920; ditto, Colombo Kach., June, 1921; Colombo Port Comsnr., Oct., 1921; ag. office astt. to astt. govt. agt., Kegalla, Jan., 1922; pol. mag., Matale, Feb., 1923; dep. rubber contr., May, 1924; astt. govt. agt., Batticaloa, Sept., 1925; ditto, Trincomalee, June, 1926.

DAVIES, THEOPHILUS ALFRED.—Temp. clk., Sierra Leone, Jan., 1885; ag. astt. examng. offr. of cust., Lavana, 1889; tide waiter, June, 1892; ag. astt. examng. offr. of cust., and postmr., Mano Salija, Mar. to Nov., 1893; prev. offr., Bassia, 1895; ditto, Kukuna, 1896; on special mission to open cust. station at Saioniya, Nov., 1896; prev. offr., Saioniya, 1896 to 1902; insp. of health, Saioniya, Tambakka dist., 1900; offr. in charge of cust. and postmr., Kambia, 1902, and 1903; sub-collr. of cust., sub-acctnt., postmr. and money order clk., Mano Salija, July, 1903, to 1905; sen. warehouseman, Oct., 1905.

DAVIES, TUDOR THOMAS.—B. 1887; astt. govt. printer, Nyassaland Prot., 1916; ag. govt. printer and compt. stationery, May to July, 1917, July, 1919 to Mar., 1920 and Apr. to Dec., 1923; govt. printer, 15th Dec., 1923.

DAVIES, WILLIAM ALFORD NOEL.—B. 1883; ed. Monmouth Gram. Schl.; admitted solr. of sup. ct., England, Apr., 1906; private practice in England, 1906-1907; private practice in E. Africa, 1907-1908; astt. dist. comsnr., Sierra Leone, Dec., 1908; passed lower standard Mendi exam., June, 1911; ag. dist. comsnr., Deo., 1911, to June, 1912; ag. pol. mag., June to Dec., 1912; acted as crown prosecutor on several occasions; ag. dist. comsnr., 1913-14; master and regisr., sup. ct., S.
